greet: GET ME OUT OF HERE! NOW!

reply: I am a great and famous actor! Not a princess, at all. I was only PRETENDING to be a princess. But try explaining that to those stupid pirates.
Stage acting was a waste of my immense talent. Not only am I a born leader, my talent is more profitable when it is used for conning people.
Stage acting was a waste of my immense talent. Not only am I a born leader, my talent is more profitable when it is used for conning people.
He was always a fool with a heart too soft to become a feared pirate.
Me playing a princess was just part of a cunning plan we had.
If you find some way to release me I might even let you live as reward! So you'd better do your best or I'll kill you!
How dare you? I left to rot in this dirty cell and you have nothing better to do than chit chat?
YOU .. YOU .. You are as good as dead! I will get you! Do you hear me? I will have your head! On a platter!
In a just world, I would be captain of a grand ship, ...
Those pirates out there would now be my minions, and we would brave the seas and become the terror of the coastal towns! ...
If only our plan had worked!
Captain Kid sold his ship to buy pointless things like those insanely expensive locks for the cell doors. ...
He said the canoes would do for a while. ...
I got the impression he was not overly sad to part with the ship because he was known to suffer a lot from seasickness.
I'd have been a much better captain then Kid was. I played several captains on stage and I was good! ...
Where Kid longed for the appreciation of his men, I would rule by fear and with an iron fist!
It was all captain Kid's idea. You see, he hated his name and planned to become known by the name captain Kidnap. ...
All he needed was someone famous to kidnap. ...
Given his men's dismal lack of talent and intelligence that would have been quite a feat. ...
We knew each other from a few scams we did together in the past, so he contacted me. ...
I was to impersonate the famous Princess Lumelia. You know, the one everyone was looking for. ...
That would show his men and the other pirates what a great kidnapper he was. ...
He promised me that I would become his second in command and lead a wonderful life of plundering, robbing and pillaging. ...
So I agreed to impersonate the Princess for a while and it worked fine at first. ...
He returned with me dressed as the Princess from a raid on his own and was instantaneously the hero of the day for his men. ...
Things went bad when they decided to have a victory party. ...
As far as I could make out from the mumblings of the pirates, Kid lost the key to my cell while relieving himself in the underground river. ...
The fool decided to dive after it .. never to be seen again. ...
When I found out about Kid's demise I tried to convince the pirates it was a hoax, but they just won't believe me!
Ah kidnapping is so much fun. That is, if you're not on the receiving end. ...
It's easy money and you have a chance to frighten and torture someone who can't fight back!
The more stupid the people are, the easier it is to con them. ...
And the poorer they are the less means they have to get revenge. Har Har! ...
So I make sure I ruin those I scam. Then they have other things to worry about than getting revenge on me.
The key was lost in the underground river and has probably washed into the seven seas by now! ...
If that stupid Kid hadn't been so obsessed with kidnapping he'd not have sold his ship to buy the most expensive and complicated locks for his cells!
As long as we stick to undefended coastal towns we can make an easy fortune. Har Har! ...
As soon as I get out of here I'll finally become a pirate captain on my own. I don't need Captain Kid!

entries.text: I am a MAN! Get me out you drunken fools!
GET ME OUT OF HERE!
Get me out! It was all part of the plan, you fools!
If I ever get out of here, I'll kill you all! All of you!
I am NOT Princess Lumelia, you fools!
Get a locksmith and free me or you will regret it, you foolish pirates!
I am not a princess, I am an actor!

........ ... Ri..... ... Ritual didn't work. RIBBIT?! I can speak the human language again! Ribbit! Well, at least sometimes it seems. Ribbit. And who the heck are you??
triggers: eeny meeny miny moe ribbit ribbit head to toe

reply: I don't want to be an assistant anymore. Ribbit. I just want my dream pond.
That old fool! He should be locked up with his weird theories and ideas and forced to study some serious magic! Rrrribbit!
Ribbit?!
Are you? I see. I saw you poking around here earlier. Ribbit. Well whatever you were trying to do, I'm not sure it was successful. Ribbit. What was that princess thing all about, anyway??
Yep, he told me one day that that was his name. In the tone of voice that makes your ears almost explode and singes your hair.
You know... being a frog isn't that bad. Ribbit. I don't want to be a human again. I just wish I could get out of this cage and live by a lovely little pond.
Magic, pah. Ribbit. I don't need magic. I just want some flies, actually. Ribbit.
That demon is called ribbit. Erm, no, I mean Samael. He is one REALLY annoyed demon overlord, but we get along okay. Not sure if I'd let him out of there though. Ribbit.
Well... ribbit... my name is Turian. But that doesn't really matter anymore.
You know... being a frog isn't that bad. Ribbit. I don't want to be a human again. I just wish I could get out of this cage and live by a lovely little pond.
I like the pond north of Thais. It's a really cosy place. Not just for humans, but especially for frogs. Ribbit.
I used to be Eclesius' assistant! Argh! Then - ribbit - one of his crazy experimental spells backfired and hit me. That's when I lost my job I guess. Ribbit.

If another prince comes to kiss me, I'll kick his ass so bad that he'll need a sedan chair to get away.
Don't even try to kiss me or I'll rondhouse kick you!
Talking frogs don't exist, idiot. It's your fucking imagination tricking you. And now your imagination commands you to walk away.
Finally someone notices I'm a FROG. Congratulations, you're VERY observant... *sigh*
A quest? Yeah I got a quest! Go and tell King Tibianus his son tried to kiss me again!
Pyrale? That idiot transformed me into an human once. But my wife came and kissed me, so I'm a frog again.
Pyrale? That idiot transformed me into an human once. But my wife came and kissed me, so I'm a frog again.

reply: Then stay here in these ghostly halls.

greet: Huh? What? I can see! Wow! A non-mino. Did they {capture} you as well?

reply: No! I won't tell you. Shame coz it would be useful for you - hehehe.
It's easy to find your way through it! Just follow the pools of mud. Hehe - useful hint, isn't it?
Hey! That's me! You got it! Thanks mate - now I remember my name!
I am the mightiest sorcerer from here to there! Yeah!
Yes, they capture people. I guess that's their job.
He is the worst of them all! He is the king of the minos! May he burn in hell!
Yeah! There are many monsters guarding my home. Only the bravest hero will be able to slay them!
Yeah! There are many monsters guarding my home. Only the bravest hero will be able to slay them!
How could I escape? They only give me rotten food here. I can't regain my powers because I have no mana!
He is the leader of the outcasts. I hope he will never conquer the city of Mintwallin. That would be the end of me!
Wait! Don't leave! I want to tell you about my surreal numbers.
Power. Hmmm. Once while we were crossing the mountains together a man named Aureus said to me that parcels are equal to power. Any idea what that meant?
I have many books in my home. But only powerful people can read them. I bet you will only see three dots after the headline! Hehehe! Hahaha! Excellent!
The only monster I cannot conjure. But soon I will be powerful enough!
My name is - uhm - hang on? I knew it yesterday, didn't I? Doesn't matter!
Better save time than comitting a crime. I am a poet and I know it!
They are trying to capture me! Or hang on! Haven't they already captured me? Hmmm - I will have to think about this.
Tataah!
Yeah! There are many monsters guarding my home. Only the bravest hero will be able to slay them!
Job? JOB? Hey man - I am in prison! But you know - once upon a time - I was a powerful mage! A mage ... come to think of it .., what is that - a mage?
Sure I have the key! Hehehe! Perhaps I will give it to you. IF you can solve my riddle.
It's easy to find your way through it! Just follow the pools of mud. Hehe - useful hint, isn't it?

Working steel is my profession.
Manny kinds of. Like {Mesh Kaha Rogh'}, {Za'Kalortith}, {Uth'Byth}, {Uth'Morc}, {Uth'Amon}, {Uth'Maer}, {Uth'Doon}, and {Zatragil}.
Most ancients use dream silver for different stuff. Now ancients most gone. Most not know about.
It's high steel called. Only lil' lil' ones know how make.
It's evil. Demon iron is. No good cyclops goes where you can find and need evil flame to melt.
Steel that is singing when forged. No one knows where find today.
Not good to make stuff off. Bad steel it is. But eating magic, so useful is.
Brightsteel is. Much art made with it. Sorcerers too lazy and afraid to enchant much.
Heartiron from heart of big old mountain, found very deep. Lil' lil ones fiercely defend. Not wanting to have it used for stuff but holy stuff.
Me parents live here before town was. Me not care about lil' ones.
Lil' lil' ones are so fun. We often chat.
One day I'll go and look.
Is one of elven family or such thing. Me not understand lil' ones and their business.
Is one of elven family or such thing. Me not understand lil' ones and their business.
I called Bencthyclthrtrprr by me people. Lil' ones me call Big Ben.
You shut up. Me not want to hear.
Do lil' one want to trade a fire sword?
Do lil' one want to trade a dragon shield?
Do lil' one want to trade a sword of valor?
Do lil' one want to trade a warlord sword?
They were friend with me parents. Long before elves here, they often made visit. No longer come here.
Me not fight them, they not fight me.
Me wish I could make weapon like it.
Me people not live here much. Most are far away.

reply: My name is now known only to the wind and it shall remain like this until I will return to my kin.
I was a guardian of this glade. I am the last one... everyone had to leave.
This glade's time is growing short if nothing will be done soon.
Take care, guardian.
Cruel beings. Large and monstrous, with a single eye, staring at their prey.

farewell: Wait right there. I will eat you after writing down what I found out.
greet: What is this? An optically challenged entity called |PLAYERNAME|. How fascinating!

reply: Yes, yes, I will kill you soon enough, now let me continue my investigation on you.
They will mourn the day they abandoned us.
I am the great librarian.
It's a fine library, isn't it?
I am 486486 and NOT 'Blinky' as some people called me ... before they died.
It's 1, not 'Tibia', silly.
Uglyness incarnate. One eye! Imagine that! Horrible!
These fools and their superstitious life cult don't understand anything of importance.
Only inferior species need weapons.
I heard that elves moved in upstairs.
Numbers are essential. They are the secret behind the scenes. If you are a master of mathematics you are a master over life and death.
Our books are written in 469, of course you can't understand them.
Go and wash your eyes for using this obscene number!
The language of my kind. Superior to any other language and only to be spoken by entities with enough eyes to blink it.
Noisy pests.
Their mages are so close to the truth. Closer then they know and closer then it's good for them.
Good tools to work with ... After their death, that is.

You pitiful two-eyed creatures. In our eyes, you look weird. It is pathetic how much you depend on hands and legs. Since we bonelords have more eyes than any creature in the world, it is obvious that you can determine the value of a species by the number of its eyes.

Our race is very old. Over the time, we have been given many different names by other races. The term bonelord sticks to us for quite a while now. In our language the name of our race is not fix but a complex formula, and as such it always changes for the subjective viewer.

Our language is beyond comprehension by your lesser beings. It heavily relies on mathemagic. Your brain is not suited for the mathemagical processing necessary to understand our language.To decipher even our most basic texts, it would need a genius that can calculate numbers within seconds in his brain.

greet: Welcome to the Tibian bank, young adventurer! Deposit your gold or withdraw your money from your bank account. Remember to deposit all of your gold before you leave here. I can also explain the {functions} of your bank account to you.

reply: My name is Adrian, how may I assist you today?
Mhm?
I`m the banker here in Targuna. It's my job to manage your bank account and change currencies.
I'm just a banker, ask around maybe someone else could need your help.
This is our little island here. We are just a small community, but we have good trade relations with the Thais.
Thais is our beautiful capital, ruled by our beloved king Tibianus III.
You can deposit and withdraw money from your bank account here. I can also change money for you.

Every Tibian has a global bank account. This means you can deposit your gold in one bank, and withdraw it from the same or any other Tibian bank in any city. ... Here on Targuna, I run the bank. I keep any gold you deposit safe, so you can't lose it when you're out fighting or dying, heh. Ask me for your {balance} to learn how much money you've already saved.
Your bank account will be used automatically when you want to rent a house or place an offer on an item on the market. Let me know if you want to know about how either one works.

Renting a house has never been this easy. Simply make a bid for an auction on the house section of the official Tibia website. We will check immediately if you have enough money ... Please keep in mind that the sum you have used to bid will be unavailable unless somebody places a higher bid. Once you have acquired a house the rent will be charged automatically from your bank account every month.

If you buy an item from the market, the required gold will be deducted from your bank account automatically. On the other hand, money you earn for selling items via the market will be added to your account. It's easy!

entries.text: Any questions about the functions of your bank account? Feel free to ask me for help!
Deposit your money here!

Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.

If you want to explore the dungeons such as the {sewers}, you have to {equip} yourself with the vital stuff I am selling. It's {vital} in the deepest sense of the word.
Oh, our sewer system is very primitive - it's so primitive that it's overrun by {rats}. But the stuff I sell is safe from them. Just ask me for a {trade} to see it!
The king encouraged salesmen to travel here, but only I dared to take the risk, and a risk it was!
Bugs plague this isle, but my wares are bug-free, totally bug-free.
One day I will return to the continent as a rich, a very rich man!
Thais is a crowded town.

Have you ever wondered what that 'main' is people are talking about? Well, once you've reached level 8, you should talk to the {oracle}. You can choose a {profession} afterwards and explore much more of Tibia.
Oh, I'm sorry, but I don't deal with weapons. That's {Obi's} or {Lee'Delle's} business. I could offer you a {pick} in exchange for a {small axe} if you should happen to own one.

Blueberries grow on bushes. They're quite common in Tibia. Just pick them from a bush if you need a snack!
Sorry, I don't sell potions. You should visit {Lily} for that.
Hmm, the best address to look for food might be {Willie} or {Billy}. {Norma} also has some snacks for sale.
A bank is quite useful. You can deposit your money safely there. This way you don't have to carry it around with you all the time. You could also invest your money in my {wares}!
The big building in the centre of Rookgaard. They have a library, a training centre, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}. {Seymour} is the teacher there.
The monk {Cipfried} takes care of our temple. He can heal you if you're badly injured or poisoned.
As a premium adventurer you have many advantages. You really should check them out!

To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.

You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8.
Seymour is a teacher running the {academy}. He has many important {information} about Tibia.
She sells health {potions} and antidote potions. Also, she buys {blueberries} and {cookies} in case you find any.
This is a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain your health, it's a good place to go. However, many monsters also carry food such as meat or cheese. Or you could simply pick {blueberries}.
This is a local farmer. If you need fresh {food} to regain your health, it's a good place to go. He's only trading with {premium} adventurers though.
She used to sell equipment, but I think she has opened a small bar now. Talks about changing her name to 'Mary' and such, strange girl.
Some call him a hero. He protects the town from {monsters}.
Some call him a hero. He protects the town from {monsters}.
Picks are hard to come by. I trade them only in exchange for high quality small axes. Would you like to make that deal?
Picks are hard to come by. I trade them only in exchange for high quality small axes. Would you like to make that deal?

send_trade: Take a look in the trade window to your left.

entries.text: Are you looking for the best trades? Come to my shop!
Feeling lost? You can always ask me about general hints!
Tools and general equipment at Al Dee's!
Don't head for adventure without a rope and torches! Buy your supplies here!

greet: Greetings, pilgrim. Welcome to the halls of hope. We are the keepers of this {temple} and welcome everyone willing to contribute.

reply: I am Albinius, a worshipper of the {Astral Shapers}.
Precisely time.
I find ways to unveil the secrets of the stars. Judging by this question, I doubt you follow my weekly publications concerning this research.

We were created to communicate the will of the gods to you inhabitants of the world of matter. The gods send us visions and insights which - in turn - we announce to you. ... Sometimes though the gods might decide to grant those visions directly to a recipient. The way how a message is delivered is of no importance. All what matters is the content of a message.

Fardos and Uman either created or awakened a new godess from her sleep: Tibiasula. She helped Fardos, Uman and Zathroth create the mighty column of Time. ... But then Zathroth killed Tibiasula and Fardos and Uman bonded her body to the column of Time, creating the elements: earth, water, fire and air.

In these dire times the gods guide their followers and chosen ones with the help of many means. Sometimes their guidance is subtle, sometimes they send visions of different kinds. Even we messengers do not directly communicate with the gods.
The fiend from beyond. Do not speak or think its name as it might draw its attention on you.
There is no Zathroth but Uman-Zathroth. They are the unfathomable god of knowledge and magic.

Some of us used to be beings like you. However, this was a long time ago and we hardly remember it. Others were created by the gods for a specific purpose. ... Even though some of us might look similar to you, each of us is a very specific individual with unique traits that you cannot perceive.
Not all is lost. The gods are rallying their forces to be prepared for the war to come. You will not fight alone. What is happening here is only the first step to prepare you.
The gods guide us through visions and dreams. They have shown us an ancient, forgotten power that will help to prepare you for the things to come.

The race of the Astral Shapers had a vast knowledge on how to imbue items with magical power. Although most of their art has been forgotten, the knowledge might be recovered by finding Shaper records which include small fractions of their weapons.
Even the sea will rise to defend the land and the land will shield the sea.
It is not yet time to name them. Even thinking about them may taint you. So watch your thoughts and take care because the enemy is powerful and devious.
Be it man or be it beast, nature must rise to face the coming onslaught.
Fardos the Creator is one of the elder gods, together with Uman Zathroth. Fardos always was driven by the need to create and give life, overflowing with creative power.
The suns will always shine on Tibia.
Nornur is the god of fate. He is a child of Fardos and the element Air.
Even his endless legions will not be enough to stop the threat. But they might turn the tides of battle.
The first paladin has visited us many time. Her insights have proven as very useful.
Kirok was created in a attempt to separate Uman and Zathroth.
Banor will recruit our forces against the fiends of beyond and you will be his vanguard!
The gods promise new hope in the fight against the fiends from beyond.

The ancient race of the Astral Shapers were highly talented in charging items with magical energy. They used mighty forges and charging stations to add special and useful properties to items. ... They were wiped out and their cities destroyed but some of their legacy survived. At certain places of power their charging stations have endured the ravages of time. ... Even though their knowledge was shattered, some of it still exists. The so-called Shaper records is a text collection which was written down in ancient times. ... It will be our duty to the gods to unearth this knowledge, find the lost forges and use them to prepare for the battles to come.
Fear not. The gods are with us. In these days this is even recognisable by the most ignorant.
There is no Uman but Uman-Zathroth. They are the unfathomable god of knowledge and magic.
May his rage strike down the enemies of creation.
Brog is the son of Zathroth and Fafnar is a malovent god. He tried to conquer the realms long ago.
The suns will always shine on Tibia.

He's the guardian of the dead. He was created by Fardos when it when he saw that Urgith wouldn't keep the dead at their rest but using them as an army of undeath. Therefore Toth is called the Warden of Souls.

send_trade: At your service, just browse through my wares.

greet: Hello.

reply: I am Aletta.
I can answer simple questions.

greet: Hi there |PLAYERNAME|, and welcome to the {magic} store.

reply: I'm selling runes, life rings, wands, rods and crystal balls. I also buy powerful spellbooks. If you like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.

send_trade: Of course, just browse through my wares. Or do you want to look only at <GetFormattedShopCategoryNames()>.

entries.text: Selling all sorts of magic equipment. Come and have a look

greet: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.

reply: This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ...
It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ...

The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ...
Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?

Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.

There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.

walkaway: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.

farewell: May your path always be even.
greet: Nature's blessing, traveller! May you not be affected by any sinister force.

reply: Outside of our secret {realm} my siblings and I can't keep our true shape. If we want to travel other parts of the world, we must take over the bodies of animals. But we are causing them no harm and we just take control if necessary.

We call it Feyrist and it is a secret, hidden place. Just few mortals get permission to enter it. A long time ago, we learned how to hide our realm from the outside world. Only if you gain our trust I will tell you how to reach it.

We call ourselves the fae. Some name us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the former term. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret realm. We only leave it in order to {protect} our home. ...

We call ourselves the fae. Some name us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the former term. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret realm. We only leave it in order to {protect} our home. ...
I can sense a kind of dark energy lately. It is pervading this world, more and more every day. Yet I don't know where it arises from nor what we could do to dispel it.
It is rather subversive, so most creatures won't sense it ... yet. But its corrosive power has already begun to affect my kind and our hidden realm in unpleasant ways.
Some call us nature spirits or peri but we prefer the term fae. Most of us are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in our secret realm. We only leave it in order to protect our home. ...

We tend to be secretive about our true nature, but I guess there was once an elven sage who visited our realm and put his experiences down on paper. There might be a book about the fae in the library of Ab'Dendriel.

walkaway: May your path always be even.

greet: Welcome to the Plank and Treasurechest Market, |PLAYERNAME|! Best trades in town!.

reply: Yes, I have a child. My son, my wife and me, we're living upstairs.
My name is Allen Richardson. I'm the owner of this market.
I run this market and sell furniture.
Well, as you can see, we sell furniture. Ask me for a {trade} if you're interested.
This is the best city in the whole world! We don't care about greedy kings or ambitious priests and the like ... One fine day our {leaders} will declare Venore's independence!
{Venore}'s wealth is based on wise decisions and transactions made by the traders union. They know what people actually want and need, unlike some magistrates or civil servants.
It is |TIME|. Too bad we run out of cuckoo clocks.
This city is somewhat outdated.
This bunch of scheming women proves {Thais}'s weakness best.

send_trade: Of course, just take at the finest furniture of Venore.

entries.text: Hey, need some furniture for your house? Come to the Plank and Treasurechest Market!

greet: Kneel before the all-devouring power of blooded decay.

entries.text: What a beautiful palace. The Kilmareshians are highly skilful architects.
The new treaty of amity and commerce with Kilmaresh is of utmost importance.
The pending freight from the saffron coasts is overdue.

greet: Oh hello, nice to see you |PLAYERNAME|. Are you here to hear some stories of my {adventures} or do you need {help}?

reply: I'm recovering from a {sea} passage.
I'm an {explorer} who seeks {adventures}.
I've been almost everywhere in {Tibia}.
I fought fierce {monsters}, climbed the highest mountains, explored the deepest {dungeons} and crossed the {sea} on a {raft}.
My voyage on the sea was exhausting. The weather was bad, the waves high and my raft quite simple. There's a certain excitement to it, though.
Sorry, I lost my watch in a storm.
Well, I can give you general {hints} or tell you about my {adventures} and many other topics. Oh, and if you are bored, I might have a small {quest} for you.
Well, I can give you general {hints} or tell you about my {adventures} and many other topics. Oh, and if you are bored, I might have a small {quest} for you.
I had no time to explore the dungeons of this isle yet, but I've seen two big caves in the East, and there is a ruined tower to the north-west. Oh, and there're the {sewers}.
I like sewers. I made my very first battle experience in the sewers below {Thais}. The small sewer system of {Rookgaard} has some nasty rats to fight.
Oh, I fought {orcs}, {cyclopses}, {minotaurs}, even {dragons}, and many other creatures.
I don't like the way they look at you. Their eye seems to pierce right through you. Creepy!
Their breath is so hot! I had to cut my hair after my last encounter with a dragon because the ends were all burnt. That's what you gotta deal with as a female adventurer!
I left my raft at the south-eastern shore. I forgot my private {notebook} on it. If you could return it to me, I would be very grateful.
I left my raft at the south-eastern shore. I forgot my private {notebook} on it. If you could return it to me, I would be very grateful.
I left my raft at the south-eastern shore. I forgot my private {notebook} on it. If you could return it to me, I would be very grateful.
I think this poor guy was a bad choice as head of the {academy}.
A fine institution, but it needs definitely more funds from the {king}.
King Tibianus is the ruler of {Thais}. The island of {Rookgaard} belongs to his kingdom.
A fine city, but the {king} has some problems enforcing the law.
The best weapons on this isle are just toothpicks compared with the weapons warriors wield on the {mainland}.
Spells are only taught in the guildhalls of the mainland.
I'm trying to explore each spot of Tibia, and one day I'll have seen it all.
If you travel to Thais, you really should visit the marvelous castle there.
You'll be surprised once you leave this island. The world outside there is gigantic.
The most important tools you need are a {rope}, a {shovel} and maybe a {torch}.
One day I fell into a hole without having a rope. I was yelling for help for three whole days! Eventually a fisherman passed by and pulled me out with his own rope, lucky me.
Sometimes I have the strong urge to use it to knock someone out.
You know, on mainland you will be able to cast magic spells which provide you with light. You won't really need torches anymore.
I have almost no money with me anyway, so no need to deposit any at the bank.
You will find your destiny. I'm sure it's something big and important.
A fine institution, but it needs definitely more funds from the {king}.
Oh, I'm sorry, but I'm not interested in buying or selling anything.
I wouldn't want to miss being a premium adventurer. Everything is so much easier!
I don't have much to say about him. I think he sells {tools}.
Never seen him around.
She seriously asked me if she could have the remains of my {raft} as fire wood! Can you imagine that??
He promised to repair my {raft}.
Did you know my name is also the name of a gem?
To me he seems a bit rude, but maybe that's just my impression.
I heard her offers are extraordinarily good.
The oracle is said to show you your {destiny} once you are level 8.
She has changed a lot since I last saw her.
I think this poor guy was a bad choice as head of the {academy}.
Hm, I think I haven't met her yet.
He brought me some of his famous rat stew. I really didn't want to insult him, but I simply can't eat something like that. So I told him I'm a vegetarian and I only eat fish. <gulps>
He's funny in his own way.
No, I didn't go to the {bank} yet.
A gentle person. You should visit him if you have questions or need healing.
Hyacinth is a great healer. He lives somewhere hidden on this isle.
He's a funny little man.
I don't really know her, but she seems to be a nice girl.
An extraordinary warrior. He's the first and last line of defense of {Rookgaard}.
An extraordinary warrior. He's the first and last line of defense of {Rookgaard}.
Not the nicest guys you can encounter. I had some clashes with them and finally ended up being their {prisoner} for a few months.
It's 'mok' in Orcish. I tell you more if you bring me some {food}.
In Orcish that's 'burp'. I tell you more if you bring me some {food}.
I speak some Orcish words, not many though, just a few basics like '{yes}' and '{no}'.
It's 'mok' in Orcish. I tell you more if you bring me some {food}.
In Orcish that's 'burp'. I tell you more if you bring me some {food}.
I speak some Orcish words, not many though, just a few basics like '{yes}' and '{no}'.
My favorite dish is {salmon}. Oh please, bring me some.
Yeah! If you give me some salmon, I'll tell you another Orcish word. Okay?
Do you bring me my notebook?
Do you bring me my notebook?

entries.text: I wish I could eat some salmon right now... best prepared in Liberty Bay style... yummy.
Wow, I'm tired. I really should get some sleep... zzzz.
What was that word again in Orcish language... hmm.
Hey you! Are you an adventurer, too?
<sings> Stormy weathers, stormy weathers... stormy weathers on the sea!
AHHHH THE PAIN OF AGESSS! THE PAIN!
Grrrr.
Fetchi maruk buta.

greet: Ahoi, young man |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to the Nordic Tibia Ferries. If you need a {passage}, let me know.

reply: You shouldn't miss the experience.
Do you want a passage to Tibia for |TRAVELCOST|?
You shouldn't miss the experience.
Do you want a passage to Vega for |TRAVELCOST|?
You shouldn't miss the experience.
Do you want a passage to Folda for |TRAVELCOST|?
Where do you want to go today? We serve the routes to Senja, {Folda} and {Vega} and back to {Tibia}.
We are ferrymen. We transport goods and passengers to the Ice Islands.
We are ferrymen. We transport goods and passengers to the Ice Islands.
Our ferries are strong enough to stand the high waves of the Nordic Ocean.
Our ferries are strong enough to stand the high waves of the Nordic Ocean.
We serve the routes to Senja, Folda, and Vega, and back to Tibia.
This island is Senja.
My name is Anderson from the Nordic Tibia Ferries.
The four of us are the captains of the Nordic Tibia Ferries.
The four of us are the captains of the Nordic Tibia Ferries.
The four of us are the captains of the Nordic Tibia Ferries.
The four of us are the captains of the Nordic Tibia Ferries.

greet: Ashari |PLAYERNAME|.

reply: I am the mistress of the hunt. At this place you may buy the food our hunts provide.
Hunting is an art, practiced too often by diletantes. Every fool with a bow or a spear considers himself a hunter.
Bow, arrow, and spear are the hunters' best friends. In the northeast of the town one of us may sell such tools.
Hunters live a life of freedom and closeness to nature, unlike a simple farmer or bugherder.
Nature is not a friend but an unforgiving teacher, and the lessons we have to learn are endless.
Watch the sky, it will tell you.
I guess it's a human god for the human sight of nature. I have not much knowledge of this entity.
If they ever existed they are gone now.
The Kuridai are too agressive not only to people but also to the enviroment. They lack any understanding of the balance that we know as nature.
The balance of nature, of course. It's everywhere, so don't ask but observe and learn.
We try to live in harmony with the forces of nature, may they be living or unliving.
The humans are a loud and ugly race. They lack any grace and are more kin to the orcs then to us.
Life and death are significant parts of the balance.
Life and death are significant parts of the balance.
I despise their presence in our town, but it may be a necessary evil.
That is the race to which I belong.
The magic they wield is all that matters to them.

farewell: Good bye and take care of you!
greet: Greetings adventurer |PLAYERNAME|. What leads you to me?

reply: It was the elite of the whole army. They were called the Red Legion (also known as the bloody legion).
The orcs attacked the workers from time to time and so they disturbed the WORKS on the city.
The soldiers treated the workers like slaves.
The General of the Red Legion became very angry about these attacks and after some months he STROKE back!
My name is Aneus, the storyteller.
I'm a storyteller.
The story of Carlin is closely related to the story of the Fields of Glory. If you are interested in details, ask me about the story.
Thais is an ancient city. It has its origin in a hamlet called Tradespot. To learn more about its growth and rise, ask someone else. I don't know this story.
The elves love stories. I learnt a lot while I lived in their city for a while. You should travel there and talk to the elves, too, and don't forget to visit their library.
Most cities have small libraries filled with treasures in the form of stories. The biggest library is located in the White Raven Monastery.
The White Raven Monastery houses the biggest library in the known world. The monks there are a bit reclusive, though, and the Isle of the Kings is somewhat difficult to reach.
The Isle of the Kings is the burial place of the Thaian nobility. For many centuries each king and many nobles have been buried there.
I don't know much about him. I only know that he's selling fish in the village.
A lovely woman. Still, I give you a hint: Better stay away from her! <grins>
I don't know much about him. He sails much and he has seen nearly the whole world.
The dwarfs have a rich history and like to tell about it. Actually some dwarfs are so old that they experienced many events in history themselves.

The gods had great influence on humanity and other races. There are many stories related to them ... In fact, there are so many stories that it won't be sufficient to talk to some people, you will also have to research many books to learn about them.
The stories about him are stories of grief, revenge and destruction. You can hear them almost everywhere. My story deals with similar topics but with other people.
This is a story for another day.
Ok, sit down and listen. Back in the early days, one of the ancestors of our king Tibianus III wanted to build the best city in whole Tibia.
Please forgive me. I forgot his name. I'm getting old.
The soldiers treated them like slaves.
You don't know what a slave is? I really hope that you will never have to make this experience.
The soldiers of the Red Legion went to the island by night. The orcs were not prepared and the Red Legion killed hundreds of orcs with nearly no loss. ... Afterwards, they walked back to the castle.

greet: Greetings, what can I do for you?

reply: I am the local representative of the explorer society.

Our noble society is dedicated to exploring the unknown. No location is too remote for our members to travel there ... No beast is too wild to be hunted. No treasure buried too deep to be unearthed ... Only the most dedicated and fearless adventurers may join our ranks.
Currently we maintain public bases in Port Hope and Northport.
The portals should be ready to be used now. If you have an orichalcum pearl with you, enter the portal.
The examination of scrolls with lizard writings is a valuable source of information.
The examination of scrolls with lizard writings is a valuable source of information.

greet: Hello, my friend. Do you seek {passage} to the island {Targuna}?

reply: My full {name} is Anna Maria Mauricia, but you may call me just Anna.
I'm offering a ferry service to the island of {Targuna}.
Targuna is a beautiful island where adventurers are always welcome. Ask me for a {passage} if you're interested.
You chose a peaceful world. Not much danger from other adventurers. Just beware the monsters. Ask me for a passage if you're interested.
The {Blue Valley} is the heart of the {Merudri} culture, or what is left of it.
The {Merudri} are warrior monks. Honing serenity, preserving their legacy, defending the {Blue Valley} and beyond.
Back when the mines were still full of ores, our island used to be a much busier place. Workers, suppliers and travelers from all over Tibia began visiting our small village.
Back when the mines were still full of ores, our island used to be a much busier place. Workers, suppliers and travelers from all over Tibia began visiting our small village.

{Thais} is actually the oldest city in Tibia. But be careful on those streets, there are bandits everywhere. ? It might be better if I take you to the {Thais Peninsula}. Ask me for a passage if you're interested.

The {Thais Peninsula} is highly recommendable for unexperienced and first-time adventurers, it's not far from the city {Thais}, too. I can take you there if you like. Ask me for a passage if you're interested.
{Avriel} runs a small shop here in the village. You can buy useful things there, but you can also sell things you no longer need. You will find his shop right south of the ferry house.
He runs the small bank in this village. You can find him over there in the house.
He is a capable fighter and keeps our village safe from the Muglex Clan goblins.
{Viola} is a good friend of mine and knows a thing or two about magic. Maybe she can teach you a few spells.
He is a friend of our guard {Gustavo} but he lives in the capital {Thais}.
Hmm, no one in the village has that {name}. Oh wait... {Gustavo} mentioned it once.

entries.text: Ready for a passage to Targuna?
No fear! This ferry will take you safely to the island of Targuna.

farewell: Please come back from time to time.

entries.text: Come in, have a drink and something to eat.

farewell: At last! Good things come to those who wait.

reply: How dare you asking me this?!? I'm Arkulius - Master of Elements, the HEADMASTER of this academy!!
I'm Arkulius - Master of Elements, the headmaster of this academy.
I have better things to do than helping you. See that ice statue over there? My dear friend Alverus needs to be revived!
Time is an illusion and completely irrelevant to me.
Weapons are for those people who aren't able to use their heads or better what's INSIDE their heads. No offence <coughs>.
Yeye, I believe you almost feel like home among all those brainless creatures!

entries.text: ...the arithmetical paradox has the same value in a metaphysical way, then...
Oh my! Alverus!! Did you really...?!?! I have to recalculate it to make sure that I made no mistake.
<mumbles>
...the minimum square deviation could cause a dislocation, in a matter of fact...
...it could be possible to bring the sphere to a destination where...
Yes, that's it! The elementary particle are corresponding to the... the ... UNBELIEVEABLE!!!

He often passes me on the way to Frodo's.
Oh, a girl like me shouldn't go to this place.
You should ask Oswald about news. He loves them.

entries.text: Hey there, up for a chat?

Those wannabe fighters are weak and most of them are unable to comprehend a higher concept like the Mooh'Tah.
I teach worthy warriors the way of the knight.
I'm known as Asrak the Ironhoof.
I pledge no allegiance to any king, be it human or minotaurean.
Your human army might be big but without skills. They are nothing than sheep to be slaughtered.
The human generals are like their warriors. They lack the focus to be true warriors.
The dungeons of your desires and fears are not only the solely ones you have to fear but also the only ones you have to conquer.
They implanted the rage in us that almost cost our existence. They used us as pawns in wars that were not ours.
Inferior creatures of rage, driven by their primitive urges. They are only useful to test one's skills.
To rely on magic is like cheating fate. All cheaters will get their just punishment one day, and so will he.
If it's truly a weapon to slay gods, it might be worth searching for it.
The city pays me well and those undisciplined gladiators need my skills and guidance badly.
The city is only a shadow of what we could have accomplished without that curse of rage that the gods bestowed upon us.
In the ancient wars we lost many things due to our rage. The only good thing is that we lost our trust in the gods, too.
The Mooh'Tah teaches control. It provides you with weapon, armor, and shield. It teaches you harmony and focus.
Rage is the legacy of Blog, the beast. It is our primary goal to overcome this rage. The Mooh'Tah is our only hope of salvation and perfection.
There is harmony in everything that is done correctly. If you feel the harmony of an action, you can sing its song.
Each harmonic action has it own song. If you can sing it, you are in harmony with that action. This is where the minotaurean battle songs come from.
Each Mooh'Tah master focuses his skills on the harmony of battle. He is one with the song that he's singing with his voice or at least his heart.
Make your will your weapon, and your enemies will perish.
Courage is the only armor that shields you against rage and fear, the greatest dangers you are facing.
Your confidence shall be your shield. Nothing can penetrate that defence.
I can teach you {healing}, {support}, {conjure} and {runes} spells. I can also tell you which spells are available at your {level}.
Healing spells: {Bruise Bane}, {Cure Poison}, {Divine Healing}, {Intense Healing}, {Light Healing}, {Magic Patch}, {Wound Cleansing}.
Support spells: {Arrow Call}, {Find Fiend}, {Find Person}, {Great Light}, {Lesser Ethereal Spear}, {Lesser Front Sweep}, {Light}.
Conjure spells: {Conjure Arrow}, {Conjure Explosive Arrow}.
Rune spells: {Destroy Field} Rune.
For level 1 I have {Arrow Call} for free, {Bruise Bane} for free, {Lesser Ethereal Spear} for free, {Lesser Front Sweep} for free and {Magic Patch} for free.
For level 8 I have {Find Person} for 80 gold, {Light} for free, {Light Healing} for free and {Wound Cleansing} for free.
For level 10 I have {Cure Poison} for 150 gold.
For level 13 I have {Conjure Arrow} for 450 gold and {Great Light} for 500 gold.
For level 17 I have {Destroy Field} Rune for 700 gold.
For level 20 I have {Intense Healing} for 350 gold.
For level 25 I have {Conjure Explosive Arrow} for 1000 gold and {Find Fiend} for 1000 gold.
For level 35 I have {Divine Healing} for 3000 gold.

entries.text: Let me speak a few words to you.
Death comes to the best of us, but this time you had no chance.

farewell: I guess someone blew out the candle.
walkaway: I guess someone blew out the candle.

greet: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?

entries.text: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.

greet: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What do you need? Have a look at my wonderful {offers} in gems and jewellery.

reply: I am a jeweler. Maybe you want to have a look at my wonderful offers.
I am Augustin.

entries.text: Gems and jewellery! Best prices in town!

greet: Welcome to my {shop}! Are you looking for a {trade}?

reply: My name is Aurelia.
Yes, that's me.
I'm the equipment trader here in Targuna. Ask me for a {trade} if you're interested.
I am selling all kinds of equipment. Let me know if you're interested in a {trade}.
I'm just a trader. But ask around, maybe someone else could need your help.
This little island is my home. Travellers always need good gear, so business is steady.
Thais is our beautiful capital, ruled by our beloved king Tibianus III.

send_trade: Of course, take a look and see what might interest you.

farewell: May your path always be even.
greet: Greetings, traveller!
walkaway: May your path always be even.

greet: Hello.

reply: I am Avan.
I can answer simple questions.

greet: Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|!
Welcome to my little shop, |PLAYERNAME|! Are you looking to {trade} anything precious?

reply: Avriel is the name, I take care of all goods, gear and supplies. Though I'm also a great at chest, ah nevermind....
Yes, that's me.
I'm the shop owner here, if you're interested ask me for a {trade}.
I am selling all kinds of equipment. Let me know if you're interested in a {trade}.
Quest? Oh no, I can't help you with that. But maybe {Viola} or {Gustavo} could use some help.
Our King Tibianus rules over everything.
Our King Tibianus rules over everything.
You should visit Thais someday, it's our capital with lots of shops, trainers and great people.
Ever since I moved here, life has just been great, if only those goblins wouldn't terrorise us. Maybe you could help us, talk to {Gustavo} for more information.
Ah, my good friend Gustavo, he's keeping us safe from the north part of this island. I heard he's talking about needing some assistance, if you're interested don't be shy to talk to him.
Viola always wins on our quiz nights, one can really learn much from her. I guess if your interested in learning more, she's the right person to talk to.
Flavius is running the bank here in Newhaven.
Anna often travels to the mainland to get supplies for my shop, it's great working with her. You can find her at the ferry house just north of here.
If you ever need someone to handle the ugly things, he's your guard to do it.
Oh yes, our Gustavo is the guard here in Newhaven. I heard he could use some help with the muglex problem, though.
These little creatures have been terrorising our village for quite some time now, I just hope we stay safe here.
These little creatures have been terrorising our village for quite some time now, I just hope we stay safe here.
Legends say that a tragic accident buried a group of miners alive. Since then their souls have been roaming these tunnels, willing to find their next victim. So please be careful there!
I once lived on the mainland a long time ago, I was working at a shop in Yalahar, but they had to close it due to some monster problems.

send_trade: Of course, take a look and see what might interest you.

greet: I wonder if we will make it this year! Say {substance} if you want to deliver Sweet and Sugary Substances, or ask me about the {mass} of substances delivered or the {base} material lured, if you want to know how the World Quest is going.
LONG LIVE THE QUEEN!
Oh, hello there!

farewell: LONG LIVE THE QUEEN! You may leave now!

reply: MIND YOUR MANNERS COMMONER! To address the queen greet with her title!
MIND YOUR MANNERS COMMONER! To address the queen greet with her title!

reply: I am Barzak.
I can answer simple questions.

greet: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|.
send_trade: Of course, just browse through my offers.

entries.text: Welcome to Ab'Dendriel's store for general goods.

walkaway: May God show you the path, |PLAYERNAME|.

farewell: Farewell, |PLAYERNAME|, I'll be here if you need me again.
greet: It is good to see you. I'm always at your {shop options}

greet: LONG LIVE KING TIBIANUS!

reply: You need one kit for each wall. Ask me for a trade if you need some.
Ask a higher official about that.
My grandfather had seen it with his own eyes!
The best sorcerers, paladins, knights, or druids of our forces are chosen to serve as Silver Guards. They are the king's bodyguards.
There are the Dogs of War, the Red Guards, and the Silver Guards.
They are our main army.
I'm healthy and vigilant.
Gorn and I searched for this weapon in the darkest corners of each dungeon, but we didn't find the slightest hint.
They are our special forces. Some serve as city guards, others as secret police.
He was one of the king's best generals, now he's a bit ...uhm... forgetful.
Too many criminals roam our streets nowadays, the Red Guards will take care of them.
He's harmless. But I doubt he'd be much help in the war against the orcs.
This man is paranoid, but I guess that's useful in his job.
We all live under the benevolent guidance of our king.
I have already told you about your mission! Haven't you wrote down everything in your logbook? Look in there if you need to refresh your memory.
Take this!
His Royal Highness ordered that the castle be open for all his subjects.
King Tibianus III is our wise and just leader!
He's a soldier of the Silver Guards.
He's a soldier of the Silver Guards.
He was wanted for a long time and was finally caught stealing some time ago.
Take this!
Take this!
Our brave army, which protects our city, consists of three battle groups.
I heard he stole some fruit he's obsessed with and got incautious.
Take this!
Our brave army, which protects our city, consists of three battle groups.
The royal jester. I don't think he's funny.
Now that the king returned, we will clean the city from all dubious persons.
An old friend of mine. He was once a great warrior and adventurer. Now he's running a shop.
King Tibianus III is our wise and just leader!
It's rumoured that Ferumbras is planning a new attack on this town.
I'm a proud member of the king's army. It's my duty to guard the castle. Sometimes I have to deal with less important work though.
He's a fine blacksmith. Almost all of our weapons are made by him.
There is almost nothing known about that organisation.
Do you bring freshly killed rats for a bounty of 1 gold each? Ask me for a trade if you want to sell them.

send_trade: Do you bring freshly killed rats for a bounty of 1 gold each? By the way, I also buy orc teeth and other stuff you ripped from their bloody corp... I mean... well, you know what I mean.

entries.text: People of Thais, bring honour to your king by fighting in the orc war!
The orcs are preparing for war!!!

send_trade: Of course, just browse through my wares.

entries.text: Selling general goods and paperware! Come to my shop!

greet: Greetings. I hope you are here on a {mission} for nature!

reply: I'm a preserver of nature. It's a sad thing, but as so many so-called intelligent beings tamper with nature's balance, it has become necessary to adjust things to maintain the balance.
The natural balance is a delicate thing. Greed is its greatest enemy. I do that little that I can do to preserve the balance.
Nature's balance sometimes seems like a myth or unreachable ideal. But we must do our part in keeping the balance because our intelligence gives us this responsibility.
There are many stories and legends about the white deer. For sure it is a magnificent beast but this might be its downfall.
Its majesty awakes the greed in the hearts of others and greed is balance's greatest enemy.
The wolves hunt their share until they feel no hunger anymore. Greedy people hunt the deer for its antlers and fur.
The lowered deer population leave the wolves starving and aggressive until they become a threat.
If we get rid of a few more of the wolves, the deer population might become stable soon.
You know his name so I assume you have talked to him. I was also rather surprised to meet a talking deer. He told me that he's not really an animal.
I know a few things about him but I'm not sure what I'm allowed to reveal. Perhaps he will tell you more about himself and the reasons for his presence here.
Many have lost their touch to nature. They have given in to greed and the excuse of necessity.
Yet, some still know, at least deep in their hearts, what is the right thing to do. This is my hope.

entries.text: Nature is in pain.
The weather is fine today.
I can hear the call of the forest.

farewell: It was a pleasure to help you.
greet: Hello. How may I help you |PLAYERNAME|? Ask me for a {trade} if you want to buy something. I can also explain the {mail} system.

reply: TO THE ARMS! MAN THE WALLS! FERUMBRAS IS NEAR!
I don't remember that someone named like that is living here.
Well, the receiver - or addressee - is the person you want to send mail to. Always make sure to enter his or her name correctly.
I know him because he always forgets to write the name of the recipient on his parcels and letters. The hardest part is to find out who he actually wanted to send it to.
Ah, King Tibianus, our wise ruler. He has been sick for some time, hasn't he?
If you want to buy a letter, ask me for a trade. Or do you want me to explain how letters work?

With a letter you can send a message to another Tibian's depot. If you want to send it to 'Ben' in Thais, use the letter - so that a form opens - and write 'Ben' in the first line. Write your message below that. ... Then drag your letter on one of the blue mailboxes here to send it.
If you want to buy a parcel, ask me for a trade. Or do you want me to explain how parcels work?
TO THE ARMS! MAN THE WALLS! FERUMBRAS IS NEAR!
Oh, young Harkath will be a fine warrior some day.
Ooooh, nice man, visits me often... I think.
I'm always in my office. You are welcome to visit me here at any time.
You can send letters and parcels to Carlin.
This naughty child, always stealing apples!
Never heard of him.
He's always talking about healing me even though I'm fine... I believe he is a bit nuts, poor man.
This Muriel has a lot of correspondence.
I don't drink alcohol while I'm on duty.

Each major city has at least one depot. Just step in front of one of the lockers and you can store items inside. Your mail will also arrive there. It doesn't matter which depot you stored it in - you can retrieve all your items from any depot in any city!
If you want to buy a label, ask me for a trade. Or do you want me to explain how labels work?
This is the town you are currently in.
Oh, she lives next door.
Frodo... Frodo... ? Uhm... isn't that the guy that brings me food at lunchtime?
That name sounds familiar... who might that be...
NO! NO! NO! GO AWAY!.
She's SO pretty!
I love his music! He's my best friend and I visit him as often as I can.
The young sorcerer is a good businessman.
Drag and drop a letter or a parcel on the blue mailbox to send it. However, you need to include the name of the receiver. If the sending fails, you most likely made a mistake.
My name is Benjamin.
Uh... oh... Uhm... Join what?
TO THE ARMS! MAN THE WALLS! FERUMBRAS IS NEAR!
Sorry, I don't read the letters we deliver.
He hangs around here quite often. He says that I inspire him.
He sells equipment.
The king? Oops, I... can't remember his name...
I'm working here at the post office. If you have questions about the Royal Tibia Mail System or the depots, ask me.
Ham? No thanks, I already ate fish.

entries.text: Welcome to the post office!
If you need help with letters or parcels, just ask me. I can explain everything.
Hey, send a letter to your friend now and then. Keep in touch, you know.

reply: I sell equipment for your adventure! Just ask me for a {trade} to see my wares.

entries.text: Hey there, need some general goods or paperware?

greet: I wonder if we will make it this year! Say {substance} if you want to deliver Sweet and Sugary Substances, or ask me about the {mass} of substances delivered or the {base} material lured, if you want to know how the World Quest is going.
Howdy |PLAYERNAME|. I'm a farmer and cook, maybe I can interest you in a {trade} with food? You can also ask me for general {hints} about the game.

reply: Billy.
I'm a farmer and a {cook}. I'd love to make pancakes, but I'm lacking a good {pan}.
I came here for peace and leisure, so leave me alone with 'time'.
Rather give your {money} to me than leaving it at the bank. Hehe.
Thank you, I'm fine.
If you need information, I can provide you with general {hints}.
I'm a cook, not a priest. If you need information, I can provide you with general {hints}.
I'm the best cook around. You can sell most types of {food} to me. Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you as well as my offers.
Which citizen?
If you bring me a fresh rat for my famous stew, ask me for a {trade}.
Nah, this is not a real shop. I have some offers, though. If you're interested, just ask me for a {trade}. There are other {merchants} on {Rookgaard} as well.
There is so much to explore! Better hurry to get to the continent! Once you're level 8, look for the {oracle}.
As an adventurer, you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
There are lots and lots of dusty books. You can read them for some basic knowledge about the world. Then again, you could also ask around in the village.
The king and his tax collectors are far away. You'll meet them soon enough.
Ask {Obi} or {Lee'Delle}. They make a fortune here with all those wannabe heroes.
This island will prepare you for the main continent of {Tibia}. Learn to fight and grow stronger!
Don't be scared, you should be safe as long as you stay in town. Dangerous monsters are roaming the {dungeons}.
You'll find a lot of dungeons if you look around. One example are the {sewers} below Rookgaard.
The local sewers are invested by {rats}. Fresh rats give a good stew, you can sell them to me.
Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you. Food of almost any kind!
To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}.
That's right, I'm the god of cooking!
I'd love to make pancakes, but I'm lacking a decent {pan}. If you get me one, I'll reward you.
Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
Armor and shields can be bought at {Dixi's} or at {Lee'Delle's}. Dixi runs that shop near {Obi's}.
Get that from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
Get that from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
Get that from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
Get that from {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
Well, no gold, no deal. Earn gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
Well, no gold, no deal. Earn gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
I can spell but I don't know any spells.
I can spell but I don't know any spells.
Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers.
I like him, we usually have a drink or two once a week and share stories about {Willie}.
That girl is all about party now. I think she was fed up with {equipment} selling.
Now that's one crazy fellow. I usually hear him scream about some hole.
He's a fisherman and somehow his hut is always infested with cockroaches.
That old hag always finds someone to do her work. I have no clue how she is doing that.
Decent guy. He sells general equipment such as {ropes}, {shovels} and so on.
She's pretty indeed! I wonder if she likes bearded men.
Gotta love that name.
Don't listen to this old wannabe, I'm the best cook around.
He never leaves the temple. He spends his time caring for those who newly arrive here. You can ask him for a heal if you are badly injured or poisoned.
That's {Obi's} granddaughter. She helps him out by selling {armors} and {shields}. I think she'll be a beauty when she's grown up.
I never see that guy around.
Her shop is super-duper exclusive. If you're a premium adventurer, check it out in the western part of town. Lotsa nice offers there.
She lives in the very south of this town, selling her potions. Sweet - well, sweet-loving girl.
You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8.
He must have the most boring job there is.
I don't like his headmaster behaviour. Then again, he IS the headmaster of the {academy}.
Tom the tanner buys what's too nasty or too old to eat, animal-wise. Dead wolves and such.
He is one of the king's best men and here to protect us.
He is one of the king's best men and here to protect us.
Have you found a pan for me?

send_trade: Sure.

entries.text: Add one fresh dead rat and stir it well...
Argh, if I only had a pan!
Bread, cheese, ham and meat! All fresh!
Buying fresh dead rats!
Buying many types of food and ingredients, too!
Hmm, hmm, now which ingredients do I need...
Need food? I have plenty for sale!

reply: It's told that some hero killed him and absorbed his power.
I know no Eclesius.
Hey, I'm Black Bert.

greet: Yarrr!

reply: I am Boasty Twoeyes.
I can answer simple questions.

farewell: Careful around the gardens! I do not want to repeat myself.

reply: The valley is rich in vegetation. Bursting of fragrance and colour in the spring and summer, it truly is a sight to behold. You need an eye and a nose for things like this, of course.

greet: Are you talking to me? Well, go on chatting but don't expect an answer.
Welcome to the Hard Rock Racing Track, |PLAYERNAME|.
Halt! This area is restricted during the siege. State your business or turn back.
Hi! I hope you're not going to kill me!

farewell: Remember: A joke a day keeps the ghouls away!

reply: A fitting place for a {jester}. I guess there are worse {jobs} around.
Bozo: Nah, no jests about His Royal Highness.
I rarely leave the castle. It's really stressful to be as popular as me.
This castle is my home. A fitting place for a jester and all other fools. Feel welcome.
I'm a jester, not a doctor!
My name is Bozo. But it's more than a name, it's a lifestyle for me!
That's me: Bozo, the jester!
Ever since the first guild was created, there is a great demand of jesters and fools to join them.
Sell? Hmm, I know a little about magic and by chance I can sell you a truly unusual {weapon}.
I know some 'monstrous' jokes!
I know the newest jokes in tibia.
Thank you, I'm fine, the gods are with me.
Pheeew! That sounds disgusting! Are you a cook at Frodo's?
Don't feed the necromants.
Are we talking about Noodles?
Are we talking about Noodles?
Hey, the little one is almost as funny as me!
Better don't mess with sorcerers!
She's pretty but too serious for my taste.
Humourless old guy! Once, he turned me into a frog for painting his distasteful cave in pink.
A man of steel with a stomach of wax. Never offer him a beer!
He's my baby brother. If you tell him I sent you, he will grant you an extra spell or two.
He sells spell scrolls each day at midnight, but you have to address him that very second.
I better make no jokes about THIS matter.
Did you know that he sells a 'power axe of doom' now? Run and buy it, he only has got three in store.
He would make a fine jester, too.
I know a lot of monster jokes. Just tell me a monster's name, come on.
Why are the experienced heroes quicker than others? ... The demons love fast food!
Where do ghouls buy their robes? ... In a boooohtique!
Why do dragons breathe fire? ... They ate too many sorcerers in chilli sauce!
Why do orcs have green skin? ... They ate at Frodo's!
How many eyes does a cyclops have? ... One for each IQ point they have!
If you believe half the rumours he's spreading, you will get in a lot of trouble.
If you are a bad jester, you get a chance to visit them now and then.
What do all little minotaurs want to become when they are grown-ups? ... Cowboys, of course!
Why do trolls live underground? ... Because there are so many pks on the surface!
Why are bonelords so ugly? ... Because their mom and dad were bonelords, too!
Why does the rat have a wooden leg? ... Because it is a former pirate!
Why did the spider cross the road? ... Because it ... oh you already know this one!?
I had a cousin named like that.
He died some years ago.
Isn't he the author of the book 'Fun with Demons'?
He is kind of a father figure to me. Of course he denies all kinship to me.
He's a smart one. I heared he hid in a foreign country as the first bugs showed up.
I am not foolish enough to believe in the existence of this weapon.
Oh, I saw some demon carvings in the dungeons as I hid there after a little joke on old Stutch.
Yes, they showed demons, seven actually, dancing around a sword! In something like a flaming pit.
Ah, don't ask me! Usually mages and mystics know more about such stuff.
I'm the royal jes ... uhm ... the royal tax-collector! Do you want to pay your taxes?
I actually know some spells! Do you want to learn how to 'lessen your load' for 200 gold?
I actually know some spells! Do you want to learn how to 'lessen your load' for 200 gold?
Do you want to buy a 'mace of the fury' for 250 gold?
Don't feed the necromancers.
Mwehehehe I like that guys humour. Although his gags and puns are most likely not intended. I wonder how he's doing, haven't seen him for a while.
Why do ghosts flee if wounded? ... They are so spineless!
Most men in town are mad about her but she is some kind of an iron maiden, you know?
Wow, your stupidity would be pride and joy for every fool. You've already applied as a member. Let's rather talk about your current mission.
Since you met me it is happy hour for you.

entries.text: Come chat with ol' Bozo!
Do you know the one with the dragon? Where - and then ... hahahaha! Oh no, I guess I ruined it.
The fools' guild? Are you serious? No, of course not! Hahaha!
Welcome, welcome, step closer!

reply: You may buy all the things we grow or gather at this place.
We abandoned the gods a long time ago. A short time after they abandoned us.
They are lost, and if they still exist they are alone in the cold and the darkness.
The Kuridai left the true path and can't see their error. Their way of living may have been suitable in the past, but if they don't come back to us, their path will lead into darkness.
We have still much to learn but we are on the correct path at least.
The Cenath forgot as many as they learned. I doubt they find the wisdom they are looking for without the things they neglected in their pursuit of knowledge.
I don't claim to understand this creatures but sometimes they are more close to the roots than we are.
They are so many, so planless, so divided. They choose a path I do not want for my own race.
Life takes many forms. Plants are a very basic form of life. Its simplicity makes them close to the core of nature.

greet: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.

reply: This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ...
It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ...

The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ...
Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?

Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.

There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.

After some time... I managed... to get ahold of myself and... dragged my body forward, deeper into the isle. I did... *cough* not encounter a single souls on my... way here, willing to... talk. ...
You are the first... I meet who is not... openly hostile. Aaah...
I... am sorry. Don't tell... Demeron... I survived. The captain he once looked up to... died in that silver mine. I... aaah... won't come back... I... leaving, the unit. ...
There is... something... I have to do, when I recover. I can't help you much more... right now. But... ah... we will meet again.

reply: This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ...
It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ...

The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ...
Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?

Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.

If I concentrate hard enough I can distinguish the many individual songs that make the melody. ... Each boulder, each stone, each grain of sand has its own voice in the symphony of the great melody.

The hunt can be part of the cycle of life and death. Nowadays that cycle has been broken. People take more than they give and greed dictates their actions.
Crunor has not forsaken us despite our failings. Crunor's love for life is truly great.

We are currently working on a huge and very ambitious project: We try to chart the world of Tibia! I know what you might think: Are there so many undiscovered places on this world? And the answer is: Yes! ... There are many secret, hidden or hardly accessible places and sites. We want to create a detailed and accurate map of our world - and we are searching for assistance concerning this project. ... So, if you want to discover Tibia's secrets, go out and discover our world, step by step and area by area. If you contribute to this project to a certain extent, you can gain the right to wear our Discoverer outfit.

My rune spells are: {Destroy Field} Rune, {Energy Field} Rune, {Energy Wall} Rune, {Fire Bomb} Rune, {Fire Field} Rune, {Fire Wall} Rune, {Great Fireball} Rune, {Heavy Magic Missile} Rune, {Light Magic Missile} Rune, {Poison Field} Rune, {Poison Wall} Rune, {Stalagmite} Rune and {Sudden Death} Rune.
For level 45 I have {Sudden Death} Rune for 3000 gold.
For level 41 I have {Energy Wall} Rune for 2500 gold.
For level 38 I have {Energy Wave} for 2500 gold.
For level 35 I have {Invisibility} for 2000 gold.
For level 33 I have {Fire Wall} Rune for 2000 gold.
For level 31 I have {Explosion} for 1800 gold.
For level 30 I have {Great Fireball} Rune for 1200 gold and {Ultimate Healing} for 1000 gold.
For level 29 I have {Great Energy Beam} for 1800 gold and {Poison Wall} Rune for 1600 gold.
For level 27 I have {Fire Bomb} Rune for 1500 gold.
For level 25 I have {Find Fiend} for 1000 gold, {Heavy Magic Missile} Rune for 1500 gold and {Summon Creature} for 2000 gold.
For level 24 I have {Stalagmite} Rune for 1400 gold.
For level 23 I have {Creature Illusion} for 1000 gold and {Energy Beam} for 1000 gold.
For level 20 I have {Intense Healing} for 350 gold.
For level 18 I have {Energy Field} Rune for 700 gold and {Fire Wave} for 850 gold.
For level 17 I have {Destroy Field} Rune for 700 gold.
For level 15 I have {Fire Field} Rune for 500 gold and {Light Magic Missile} Rune for 500 gold.
For level 14 I have {Magic Shield} for 450 gold and {Poison Field} Rune for 300 gold.
For level 13 I have {Great Light} for 500 gold.
For level 10 I have {Cure Poison} for 150 gold.
For level 8 I have {Apprentice's Strike} for free, {Find Person} for 80 gold, {Light} for free and {Light Healing} for free.
For level 1 I have {Buzz} for free, {Magic Patch} for free and {Scorch} for free.
... Selling spells.
... Only sorcerers...
... Chatterbone
... Selling spells.
... we hid it... so long ago... so long...
... we conquered them... held them so long... long ago...
... Time?... Not important... anymore.
... Maaaaassssterrrrr

greet: Hey there! You don't happen to have some {food} on you, you're willing to share? Well, where are my manners, a warm welcome for now.
Hello.

reply: I am Cheaty.
I can answer simple questions.
