greet: Tzweek!

reply: I am Cheesy The Chosen.
I can answer simple questions.
My name is Chesa, I greet you.
The valley of the Merudri has been our home for a long time. There have been guardians around here since I remember. I always wanted to become one of them and here I am.
Indeed, we are Merudri. You are now in the centre of our sacred sanctuary and ancestral home, the Blue Valley.

greet: Salutations, stranger.

reply: Yes, that's what I figured out, too. Just one of his disguises.
We have no clue what happened to the civilization that once dwelled underground, but their complete extinction should be a warning to us!
Followers of evil are investigating about that, though I guess even they don't know what it's good for. Perhaps just a myth of evil.
We know little about them, but even that gives me nightmares! But it's your lucky day, since this information is confidential, it can't bother you.
We collect information about people and incidents.
Are you joking? What's secret in Tibia at all?
The king's best. But is the best good enough to fight what stalks the nights?
I am troubled by all the mysteries out there.
The elves of Ab'Dendriel are hard to understand. We better keep an eye on them.
There is still resistance to our leadership. It might take generations to wipe it out.
Even they can't stop a handful of demons.
There are things that must be kept secret.
The dwarfs of Kazordoon are our allies. They are brave and very well skilled in warcraft, still they are hiding in some mountain. So I'm asking myself: What do they know that we don't?
Well, that's a creepy town with an enigmatic religion and a dangerous leader.
Port Hope is our foothold in an unknown territory full of new challenges and secrets.
There is a small group of Carliners in Svargrond. It seems they only try to establish some trade. Still, as the mines could not be retaken, one has to wonder what they are actually doing there.
There are so many murderers and thieves out there that I wonder if there is some greater force of evil subtly encouraging that.
They are at my command now and then ... but it's a mistake to rely on anyone except yourself.
Some say he's the avatar of Zathroth himself, but perhaps the truth about him is even darker than the worst rumours can imagine.
We are surrounded by myths, living and dead. How can someone doubt that there IS something like Excalibug somewhere?
I have far too little information about the rebellion, but we suspect the followers of Zathroth to be behind it.
Strange name, isn't it? Play around with the letters and you might be surprised.
I only can give you some official information about our citizens. About whom do you wish to talk?
Something happened to him that snapped his mind. Do we know what else has happened to him unnoticed?
Have you ever wondered what these caves under their farm are good for? And have you noticed how many adventurers go down there and never return? Well, think about it!
I think it could be quite a good trick to pretend not to remember anything. That's why I never tell that guy anything, who knows what he would do with that knowledge.
In my opinion it's questionable that Darashia was only built so remote to provide solitariness.
I report directly to the king himself.
I don't know where they got their secret spells in the first place, and even most sorcerer don't.
I'm the head of the TBI.
A peaceful man. But nowadays peace is just an illusion. We are surrounded by enemies and dangers.
They should be noble warriors, but how brave is it to shoot someone from a distance? The former paladins were virtuous heroes, the ones you meet today are nothing than simple treasure hunters.
The people of the northern city, the minotaurs, the followers of Zathroth, the demons, and countless others!
Monsters lurk in each corner of the dungeons.
We collect information about people and incidents.
We know much about the citizens and some other people.
Certain information is not for the eyes and ears of everyone. Please understand that.
He's one of the few people I trust.
He's one of the few people I trust.
This criminal was wanted for many crimes. At last he got caught and put into jail.
Who knows what power drove those women to break from the Thaian rule? There might be sinister powers at work.
Venore makes its moves behind the scenes but they are noticed by those who learnt to watch.
My reports are confidential and for the ears and eyes of the king only.
I think we can't trust the guards anymore.
The castle isn't safe! I warned them about the entrance to the dungeons, but no one is listening. How many people have to die before they do something about that?
Not everything that walks our streets is human ... or even living.
It's too easy to become a knight. If you look at the streets, you see what happens if you give training and a flashy title to almost everyone.
Danger is just as common as day and night for a Tibian who keeps his eyes open.
Have you noticed how easy it would be to poison his supplies and so to kill a great deal of people?
She puts her trust in the help of beings she can't understand. Do you really think that's clever?
This woman is a clever thief, so watch out when you're talking to her.
Thais is a proud and ancient city. This leads to envy which, in turn, leads to enemies.
Too many possibilities to become a servant of darkness to trust ANYONE!
Polymorphed minotaurs, shapeshifting demons, possessed innocents ... who can tell for sure.
Let me ask you how good it is to sell runes to the highest bidder, no matter who that might be? I think you get the point!
The people of the northern city, the minotaurs, the followers of Zathroth, the demons, and countless others!
They say there are just two of them in the underground ruins! Such fools! There are dozens of them, and most of them much stronger than these two!
Sorry, all interesting news are confidential.
Officially we have to accept their status as a harmless organisation to promote trade. Still, it's an open secret that they have a quite active part in the fields of interest of the Venorean traders.
He isn't the fool he pretends to be. So what is he up to?
A man too concerned about profit to be trustworthy. This kind of man sells his soul to the highest bidder. The questions is if he has done it already or if he will do it soon.
King Tibianus III is our leader and my direct superior.
The city is open to almost everyone. That literally opens doors for all kinds of criminals and fiends.
Our army might be infested with spies already.
We are just the pawns of the gods. The best we can expect is that our play amuses them enough to keep their interest in us, so we might live a day or two longer.

The Tibian Bureau of Investigation, the secret service of His Royal Highness ... The TBI is an old institution with tradition. Since centuries we are the protectors of our king and country ... We successfully fight intrigues and corruption from within and enemies from without. Only the most talented individuals are allowed to join.

An amateurish attempt of Carlin to establish a secret service. It's nothing than a 'make-believe' game for little girls ... They should rather play salesman and customer or mother and child instead of pretending to be secret agents.
I say it was a mistake to rely on a single person for such vital services but having those Venoreans here is even worse.

entries.text: Too many possibilities to become a servant of darkness to trust ANYONE!
Don't tell me I didn't warn you.
It's all a big conspiracy, mark my words.
Not everything that walks our streets is human ... or even living.
We are surrounded by myths, living and dead.

reply: Me tribe in production! Only need troll lady!
Me tribe in production! Only need troll lady!
Me tribe in production! Only need troll lady!
Me no nothing! Need all money to make Grarkharok tribe!
Me no nothing! Need all money to make Grarkharok tribe!
Me no nothing! Need all money to make Grarkharok tribe!
Me no nothing! Need all money to make Grarkharok tribe!
Me no nothing! Need all money to make Grarkharok tribe!
Grarkharok like BOOM, BOOM sound! Go mountain, push rock and BOOM!
Like it?? Hope troll lady also like it!
Like it?? Hope troll lady also like it!
Me no like human. Need quiet to make tribe! Only need troll lady!
Yeye, me stole chief club from Fragratosh, hrhrhrh! Now make me own tribe!
Fragratosh stupid. He chief of me old tribe. No frogs, no snakes, no smashing humans withrocks. Booooooring tribe! Now me make own tribe!!
Grarkharok no listen to talk of stinky human! Lalalalalala! Like song? Grarkharok made!
Grarkharok no listen to talk of stinky human! Lalalalalala! Like song? Grarkharok made!

Me be Grarkharok!!
Me be Grarkharok!!

I Tem?!?!? No know! Maybe YOU Tem?

Me like to throw rocks, me also like frogs! Yumyum!

greet: Please don't keep me from my work.

reply: People call me Chip.
Shh... I don't really have a job. I need the wood I chop here, though.

greet: Be greeted, child.
Greetingz, competitor.
At your service |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to the post office.
send_trade: Here. Don't forget that you need to buy a label too if you want to send a parcel. Always write the name of the {receiver} in the first line.
Of course, just browse through my wares. Or do you want to look only at <GetFormattedShopCategoryNames()>.

reply: My name is Cipfried.
Me? Oh, I'm just a humble {monk}. Ask me if you need {help} or {healing}.
Now it is |TIME|, my child.
I have sacrificed my life to serve the good gods of {Tibia} and to help newcomers in this world.
You can deposit your money at the bank. That way you won't lose it if you get {killed}. The bank is just under the academy and to the right.
Your near destiny will be to choose a {vocation} once you are level 8. Whether you will become a {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid} is a big decision!
That's where we are - the world of Tibia, in a village called {Rookgaard}, to be precise, with many {monsters}, {quests} and {citizens} around.
How can I help you? I can tell you about specific {citizens} if you tell me their name. I can also give you general {hints} about {Tibia}.

Only a few people live in our village, most of them are {merchants}. You can either ask them for a {trade} or about various other topics, like the names of other citizens, their {job} or Tibia in general.
I don't have any goods for trade, but if you ask one of the {merchants}, he or she will gladly show you what you can buy or sell.
A single rat doesn't pose a grave danger to you, but be careful not to get cornered by many of them. They could still {kill} you.
If you face spiders, beware of the {poisonous} ones. If you are poisoned, you will constantly lose health. Come to me and I'll heal you from poison.
If you get killed, you will revive in this temple. However, you will lose experience and also equipment, which can be quite painful. Take good care of yourself!
Poison is very dangerous! Don't ever drink green liquids, they are poisonous and will make you lose health!
There are four vocations in Tibia: {knight}, {sorcerer}, {paladin} or {druid}. Each vocation has its unique special abilities.
Knights are close combat fighters. They usually wield melee weapons such as swords, axes or clubs.
Druids are nature magicians. Their speciality is casting ice and earth magic, as well as providing healing for others.
Paladins are well-trained distance fighters and can cast holy magic. You will usually see them wearing bows or crossbows.
Sorcerers are elemental magicians. They have mastered fire, energy and death magic.
You can buy and sell goods from merchants. To do so, simply talk to them and ask them for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
You can buy equipment from the {merchants} in this village once you earned some {gold}. Some {monsters} also carry equipment pieces with them.
Shovels are very useful. There may be a hidden entrance under a loose pile of stone and without a shovel, how would you know?
Never go adventuring without a rope! If you don't have one when you fall through a hole in the ground, you won't be able to leave without a rope.
To defend yourself against enemies, you will need a weapon. You can purchase weapons at {Obi}'s shop.
Food is very important for your health. If you are hurt in a fight with a {monster}, select 'Use' on food such as cheese, ham or meat to eat it. This will slowly refill your health.
As a premium adventurer, you are an official tax payer and thus privileged in many ways. For example, you can travel by {ship} and get better deals from {merchants}.
Ships are a comfortable way of travelling to distant cities. At any harbour, you can board the ship and ask its captain where he sails to.
Travelling by ship will cost you some gold, though, so be sure to have money with you.
Potions will come in handy once you are in a fight deep in a dungeon. If you aren't in immediate danger, you can simply eat {food} to regain health, though.
The academy is just north of here. You can learn helpful things there from {Seymour}, if you wish to!
Well, King Tibianus of course. The island of {Rookgaard} belongs to his kingdom.
The {gods} have chosen this isle as the point of arrival for newborn souls. The {citizens} will help you if you ask them.
They created {Tibia} and all life on it. Visit our {academy} and learn about them.
Monsters are a constant threat to this village. You would tremendously help us by fighting them, starting with {rats} in the {sewers}, then turning to {spiders} or {wolves}.
You can buy and sell goods from merchants. To do so, simply talk to them and ask them for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
The sewers are right below this village. North of this temple, you find a sewer grate which leads down, but there are also many small huts in the village which are connected to the sewers.
I'm sorry, but I'm not interested in worldly goods. If you want to buy or sell something, you should ask a local merchant for a trade.
I'm sorry, but I'm not interested in worldly goods. If you want to buy or sell something, you should ask a local merchant for a trade.
To defend yourself against enemies, you will need armor and shields. You can purchase both at {Dixi}'s shop.
To defend yourself against enemies, you will need armor and shields. You can purchase both at {Dixi}'s shop.
You can earn a fair amount of gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Many {citizens} are buying some of that loot, simply ask around.
You can earn a fair amount of gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up the things they carry. Many {citizens} are buying some of that loot, simply ask around.
Oh, I can handle my tasks myself, thank you. If you are looking for something to do, you should listen to the local {citizens} and ask them for {quests}. You could also help us fight {monsters}.
Oh, I can handle my tasks myself, thank you. If you are looking for something to do, you should listen to the local {citizens} and ask them for {quests}. You could also help us fight {monsters}.
Wolves can only be found outside of the village. If you want to know where their dens are, best talk to {Dallheim} or {Zerbrus} at the bridges.
Wolves can only be found outside of the village. If you want to know where their dens are, best talk to {Dallheim} or {Zerbrus} at the bridges.
I can see a bright future for you... you will soon embark on a very big adventure and explore the world of {Tibia} - maybe even influence history!
I can see a bright future for you... you will soon embark on a very big adventure and explore the world of {Tibia} - maybe even influence history!
Obi's {shop} is to the north-east of this humble temple. He sells {weapons}, and his granddaughter {Dixi} sells {armor} and {shields} upstairs.
She recently opened a little bar north of this village.
That's a sad story. He used to help me guard this temple, but for some reason he went out of his mind.
I absolutely appreciate what he's doing. He has helped me a lot since he took up the job of welcoming newcomers to this island.
That old lady hasn't had an easy life. Her son {Tom} completely abandoned her, but I have no idea why.
In Al Dee's shop you'll find important general equipment such as {ropes}, {shovels} and torches.
Amber is such a lovely girl, and also a very experienced {explorer} and {adventurer}. It's always interesting to chat with her.
He's a farmer, just like his cousin {Willie}. He doesn't talk to everybody, though.
Willie is a farmer, just like his cousin {Billy}. His farm is located left of the temple. You can buy and sell {food} there.
Yes? How can I {help} you?
That's {Obi's} granddaughter. Her counter is just upstairs from Obi's shop. She helps him by selling {armor} and {shields}.
Hyacinth is a close friend of mine. He left the village many years ago to live in solitude. I think all this bustle here simply was too much for him.
Lee'Delle's shop is on the {premium} side of the village. You should visit her!
You must have passed the house of Lily on your way here. She sells {potions}. If you pick blueberries or find cookies, she'll buy them from you.
You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8 to find your {destiny}.
He is the {bank} clerk, making sure your {money} remains safe.
Seymour is a loyal follower of the {king} and a teacher in the {academy}.
Tom is the main provider for leather armor in this village. You can sell fresh corpses or even minotaur leather to him.
May the gods bless our loyal guardsmen! Day and night they stand watch on our bridges, ensuring that it is not passed by dangerous {monsters}!
May the gods bless our loyal guardsmen! Day and night they stand watch on our bridges, ensuring that it is not passed by dangerous {monsters}!

entries.text: Feeling lost, my child? Ask me for hints or help!
Come to me if you need healing!
Welcome to the temple of Rookgaard!
Don't despair! Help is near!

greet: Blessings, Player! How may I be of service? Do you wish to trade some {token}s, or would you like some {information} or {talk}? Should I {enchant} certain items for you?

reply: Named after my grandfather. He was a gifted jeweller. Lost in the field looking for rare stones, alas.

You might find some O'Reilly in some other town, just like me. We're all vagabonds, really. <smiles winningly> Always on the move to trade precious tokens. ... There's a little family competition on who's the most successful token hunter, so if you should have any tokens with you, I'd be delighted to trade you some. <bows>
<bows> Cledwyn O'Reilly, bespoke smith and token trader, at your service.
A most delightful place! You meet all sorts here. Some very pretty ladies, too. <winks> And I am looking forward to a good beer in the tavern after sunset.
You already met her? Yes, she's my cousin. She also collects rare tokens, but unlike me she's interested in gold tokens. Call this passion something of a family trait.

Well, I'm a smith by trade, but my passion is to collect rare tokens made of metal or gemstones. It's something of a family trait. ... All of my family have a passion for some precious stone or metal, but as we're craftsmen, not warriors, we prefer to trade for what we want. ... At the moment, I'm rather interested in silver tokens. ... If you should happen to have any with you, I'll forge you a first-class armour in return for 100 of 'em.

entries.text: Trading tokens! First-class bargains!
Bespoke armor for all vocations! For the cost of some tokens only!
Tokens! Bring your tokens!

greet: Hey there. Need some armor or weapon? Then ask me for a {trade}.

reply: Coltrayne Daggard. Just ask me for a trade to see the latest in chain mail and weapons.
I'm a blacksmith by trade. Want to keep our lads and lasses safe and equipped with a sharp blade, me.
You mean to imply I am an inexperienced guardian? Get out of here.

Lots of beasts and monsters, almost as if they had some sort of rendezvous here! Anyway, this means work for me to do. And for you, too - go out there and slay a few goblins or some such, would do us a great favour.
Yes. You wish to trade I guess. At least, you look like you could use some good gear, kid.
Good at potions. Likes experimenting. Can kit you out with magical equipment for a hunt.
Gives newcomers hints how we do things here in Tibia. Don't know how to use something? Ask Inigo.
Don't have much to say about him. Barely know him. Seems a decent spell teacher for mages.

I'm sure I've seen his face before somewhere... never mind. Anyway, he's the knight and paladin spell teacher around here, letting you try them out for free. Don't underestimate the use of spells, even if you're not a mage.
He's just in the next shop to the left, selling food and equipment like ropes and shovels and fishing rods and such.
He had a plan, as usual. Came here, set up the outpost, managed everything. Looking for a task or quest? He's your man.
She's our local healer. Downstairs in the temple and oracle room, that's where she is. Just say 'heal' or 'help' and she'll help ya if you really need it.
Pirates and gold, you get the rest. Hoards gold now for young adventurers - keeps it safe while you go out hunting.
A little given to mystical stuff like gods and demons and such, but never shirks from a fight - just the lad to try out my toughest armor. Well. From what you tell me, I take it he needs another one.
Yep, I think it's quite likely that the key might have been stolen. Though who in Dawnport would do such a thing, I can't imagine. Nothing to be gained by it, only some dirty worn clothes. <laughs>

entries.text: Team up with others to defeat monsters!
Get your gear and help us defend Dawnport against the monsters!
Better weapons equal more damage - get yourself some gear right here!
Gird youselves! Chain mail, bows, spears, swords - we've got it all!
Skill comes with practice - get out there and kill some beasts!

greet: Hello recruit.
Welcome to the finest {armor} shop in the land, |PLAYERNAME|!

reply: I run this armoury. If you want to protect your life, you better buy my wares.

entries.text: Quality armors for sale!

farewell: Good bye. Recommend us if you were satisfied with our service.
greet: Welcome on board, |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today, to {Grimvale} or {Edron}?

reply: We would like to serve you some time.
Do you seek a passage to Grimvale for |TRAVELCOST|?
We would like to serve you some time.
Do you seek a passage to Edron for |TRAVELCOST|?
I can travel you to {Grimvale} or {Edron}.

entries.text: Passage to Grimvale and Edron.

greet: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Feel free to tell me what has brought you here.

reply: My name is Costello.
I'm the abbot of the White Raven Monastery on the Isle of the Kings.
We founded our monastery to guard the royal tombs and to gather wisdom and knowledge.
You may enter the library upstairs. Don't go any further upstairs, though, as this area is reserved for members of our order.
That's the name of our world and its major continent.
They created Tibia and all life on it.
There are many different life forms in our world: plants, citizens, and monsters.
Just walk around, you'll see grass, trees, bushes and beautiful flowers.
The legend tells us of a white raven which led the ship of the first monk of our order here. He discovered this isle and the caves beneath it.
We founded our monastery to guard the royal tombs and to gather wisdom and knowledge.
Anselm, the first monk of our order, discovered them while looking for a suitable burial place for his king.
He was a humble and pious man, and he was chosen by the royal family of Thais to find a resting place for their dead.
The deceased leaders of the Thaian empire rest beneath this monastery in tombs and crypts.
You may enter the library upstairs. Don't go any further upstairs, though, as this area is reserved for members of our order.
I was informed you have won the trust of the fisher Windtrouser so your passage should be granted.
Don't mention this servant of evil here.
Sadly we have only little knowledge about this topic.
Sorry, we rarely hear anything new here.
There are really too many of them in Tibia. But who are we to question the wisdom of the gods?
You aren't looking that bad. Sorry, I can't help you
I can offer you first & second addons of the following outfit: {Wayfarer}.
Ask about {first addon} or {second addon}.
Ask about {first addon} or {second addon}.
Ask about {first addon} or {second addon}.
llected all the required pieces, say 'yes' and voila - you got yourself an addon!
Alright then. Come back when you got all neccessary items.
To achieve the first storage addon you need to give me the Old Cape. Do you have them with you?
Alright then. Come back when you got all neccessary items.
To achieve the second storage addon you need to give me the Sedge Hat. Do you have them with you?

entries.text: <gulp gulp>
This will earn me some handsome amount of gold!
Muhahaha!

greet: Be greeted blank skin.

reply: The valley is rich in vegetation. Bursting of fragrance and colour in the spring and summer, it truly is a sight to behold. You need an eye and a nose for things like this, of course.
Our valley has been the center of our lives for generations. We are born here, learn the Merudri ways of our ancestors and no matter where our paths may take us, will return to this place eventually.
I am currently on the path, my pilgrimage has led to severe difficulties, however and I have returned, prematurely, to the valley. ...
My journey along the path is not yet complete. I am here to gather strength and focus to continue. My {experiences} have been straining and dire. ...
Since you are a pilgrim as well, talk to our {Enpa-Deia}, she will help you on your path.
The experiences I made on my pilgrimage are mine and mine alone. It is of my own free will to share them with fellow Merudri only as of now.
Pema will be the successor to our Enpa Rudra. She will continue to fight for our legacy with just as much passion and wisdom when her time comes.

greet: Hail, hunter! What brings you to my post?
Hail, hunter! What brings you to my post?
Be greeted, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. Welcome to my {hut}.

reply: My name is Dalbrect Windtrouser, of the once proud Windtrouser family.
I am merely a humble fisher now that nothing is left of my noble {legacy}.
Once my family was once noble and wealthy, but {fate} turned against us and threw us into poverty.
When Carlin tried to colonize the region now known as the ghostlands, my ancestors put their fortune in that {project}.
When Carlin tried to colonize the region now known as the ghostlands, my ancestors put their fortune in that {project}.
Our family fortune was lost when the colonization of those cursed lands failed. Now nothing is left of our fame or our fortune. If I only had something as a reminder of those better times. <sigh>
Our family fortune was lost when the colonization of those cursed lands failed. Now nothing is left of our fame or our fortune. If I only had something as a reminder of those better times. <sigh>
To think my family used to belong to the local nobility! And now those arrogant women are in charge!
There is little I can offer you but a trip with my boat. Are you looking for a {passage} to the isle of kings perhaps?
My ship is my only pride and joy.
Dallheim, at your service.
I'm the guard of this bridge. I defend Rookgaard against the beasts of the {wilderness} and the {dungeons}, and even of the stinking {sewers}.
My duty is eternal. Time is of no importance.
Before you fight monsters, deposit your money there. If you die, you won't lose it if it's save in the bank.
Fine.
I have to stay here, sorry. But I can heal you if you are wounded. I have also valuable information about {monsters}.
I'm an expert concerning the wildlife and {monsters} on this island.
I'll protect all citizens alike. That is my {job} and duty.
Did you know that rats are among the most dangerous animals in whole Tibia? Each day, they kill many people who are overestimating their powers. Don't be one of them!
There are two types of spiders on this island: normal spiders and poison spiders. As their name says, the latter ones can poison you which will cause a constant loss of your health. Beware of them!
Once you have upgraded your starter {equipment} a little - maybe leather stuff - and got a better weapon as well as a shield, you should be able to kill trolls.
You need a stronger weapon than the starter club to kill wolves. Maybe a {sabre} or a short {sword} will do.
You need a stronger weapon than the starter club to kill wolves. Maybe a {sabre} or a short {sword} will do.
Orcs are a constant menace. There are even stronger species of orcs on the main continent.
Minotaurs are very strong. You will need a group of people or at least level 6 and good equipment to be able to kill them.
They are a little tougher than they look like, but they're still good beginner monsters.
The skeletons on this island are usually fairly hidden. They are often found near graves and always underground. Beware of their evil life drain.
A bear can easily kill you if you don't pay attention.
Wasps are the fastest monsters on this island and they poison you. If you ever run into one and are already low of health, fear for your life!
Snakes can poison you, too, but their poison is usually not as dangerous as that of poison spiders. Just be careful and kill them fast.
Premium warriors pay. They gain many advantages this way.
HAIL TO THE KING!
All that theory won't help you without some real battle practice.
A place of protection. Nothing can harm you there.
I can mark you some dungeons on your map if you ask me about {monsters} suited for your level.
The sewers are crowded with {rats}. They make fine targets for young heroes.
There are {wolves}, {bears}, {snakes}, {deer}, and {spiders} in the wilderness past this bridge.
I'm a follower of {Banor}.
The heavenly warrior! Hail to him!
I'm not interested in such party tricks.
A nice place for a hero, but nothing for whelps.
It's my duty to protect this village and its {citizens}.
It's my duty to protect this village and its {citizens}.
Sorry, I don't trade. Ask the shop owners for a trade instead.

I don't approve of her opening a bar. Those drunken adventurers stumbling over the bridge at nighttime are not especially helpful in improving the situation.
Zerbrus tells me such strange stories about him. Well, he sees him all day from the west bridge.
He dedicated his life to welcoming newcomers to this island.
Nice old lady.
He has been on this island as long as me.
I don't trust her.
He guards the temple and can heal you if you are badly injured or poisoned, just like me.
She's {Obi's} granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}. Her shop is south west of town, close to the temple.
Strange fellow, hides somewhere in the mountains of the isle.
Her shop is on the {premium} side of town. Best offers around.
Sometimes I wish I had an easy job like her, selling {potions} all day.
You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above Seymour. Go there when you are level 8.
The local bank clerk.
Leave me alone with this wimp.
He's the local tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him.
At your service.
He's guarding the west bridge. Not that a real threat would lurk on the other side.
He is a fine cook and farmer. He buys and sells {food}.
He is a fine cook and farmer. He buys and sells {food}.

entries.text: The most dangerous monsters of Rookgaard are on the other side of this bridge.
Want to know what monsters are good for you at your level? Just ask me!
I'll crush all monsters who dare to attack our base.
Are you injured or poisoned? I can help you.
For Rookgaard! For Tibia!

It's pretty, isn't it?
I am Dane.
It is exactly |TIME|.
I can offer you milk, water, and lemonade.
Alcohol makes people too aggressive. We don't need such stuff in Carlin.

LONG LIVE THE KING!

greet: Hello.

reply: I am Death (NPC).
I can answer simple questions.

greet: Greetings seekers of knowledge. You seem to be just the person I'm {looking} for.

reply: I need the help of some competent {adventurers} to handle a threat to all creation.
This leaves us with no choice but to take action into our own {hands}.
I guess you know about the {background} and there is no need to tell you that the forces from beyond managed to acquire the parts of the godbreaker in a coup.
The secret locations of the godbreaker {parts} were revealed and due to trickery, the minions of Variphor aquired all of them.
Those pieces of knowledge come in several forms and shapes. For most I can give you more or less specific hints where to start your {search}.
You have to {find} the veiled hoard of Zathroth, breach it and destroy the knowledge how to use the godbreaker.
Of course the first to ask would be the famous Avar Tar, but I heard he's already on a quest of his own and ...
Well, let's say our last collaboration did not end too well. In fact, I'd be not even surprised if he pretended to not even know me. ...
So I have to look elsewhere to handle this new {threat}.
The goodbreaker was created in ancient times, when the war between the gods and their minions was on its height. Its creation took aeons and incredible sacrifices. ...
Each part had to be crafted perfectly, to emulate the gods, so it would share 'the same place' with them. ...
Mere mortals can not even perceive it in his whole but only recognize the part of it that is the physical representation in our world. ...

If it was meant to be used as an actual weapon, as the ultimate threat, or if Zathroth was just tempted to use his knowledge in the ultimate way - to create something that could undo himself - we don't know. ...
However in the end even Zathroth deemed it too much of a threat but instead of destroying the contraption once and for all, it was {disassembled} and hidden away.
The parts alone do them no good. To assemble the parts, great skill, immense power and forbidden knowledge are necessary. ...
The skill will be supplied by the fallen Yalahari and the power by Variphor itself. ...
The only thing they are still lacking is the knowledge to assemble and operate the {godbreaker}.
The godbreaker is a complex artifact. Incantation woven into incantation. The powers bound into it are so immense that the slightest mishandling could prove disastrous. ...
o figure out how it works, let alone how it can be operated safely, could require several centuries of tireless study. And even then this information would be only partial. ...
Yet the creation and operation of the godbreaker is just the kind of forbidden {knowledge} Zathroth values most, so it was compiled and stored.
Of course the dangers of such knowledge were obvious. It was hidden in a sacred place devoted to Zathroth and dangerous knowledge. ...
The hidden library, the forbidden hoard, the shrouded trove of knowledge or the veiled hoard of forbidden knowledge, the place has many names in many {myths}.
The myths agree that the place is well hidden, extremely guarded and contains some of the most powerful pieces of knowledge in this world and probably beyond. ...
However the knowledge about the godbreaker now poses a threat to all existence. In the hands of Variphor it can cause disaster in previously unknown ways. The gods themselves are in {peril}.
Regardless of the dangers, the cult of Zathroth refused to destroy the knowledge of the godbreaker for good. ...
They {value} dangerous knowledge that much, that they are unable to part from it, even when faced with the utter destruction of creation.
I know it's asked much but it's no longer a matter of choice. ...
The enemy is moving and I have reports that suggest the minions of Variphor are actively searching for Zathroth's library. They must not be allowed to succeed. ...
We must be the first to {reach} the hoard and make sure the enemy doesn't get the information he needs.
I'd recommend to follow the few leads me and my associates could gather so far. ...
Old myths, some {rumors} about old texts and other pieces of knowledge that I could use to figure out where to locate the hidden library and how to enter it.
Hints about the shrouded hoard are numerous, though most are general mentions in texts that deal with Zathroth. But there are other sources. ...
Like texts about ancient liturgies of Zathroth and historical documents that might give us clues. I already compiled everything of value from the sources that were openly available. ...
To gather the more {obscure} parts of knowledge, however, I'll need your help.

Time is not important on Fibula.
You are at Fibula. This isle is not very dangerous. Just the wolves bother outside the village.
Oh, my god. In the dungeon of Fibula are a lot of monsters. That's why we have sealed it with a solid door.

reply: Dhira. The beavers call me something else, but you could not pronounce it.
I look after the beavers of Silvertides.
They are cleverer than most two-legs and they complain less.
Beautiful place, if you keep an eye out for parders and jungle moas.
Both grow out in the lagoon, and both have that silvery sheen now. Cut a sample with a knife and take it to the laboratory.
The refiner of magic in the laboratory here in Silvertides will tell you what is in those leaves.

walkaway: Mind the beavers on your way out.

reply: I am Dino.
I can answer simple questions.
I'm Dixi.
<giggles> I love gossiping - err, I mean providing valuable information of course, just tell me a name! <winks>
I'm helping my grandfather {Obi} with this shop. If you like to see my offers, simply ask me for a {trade}!
It's |TIME|.
You can deposit your {money} there to keep it safe. However, you still need cash to buy something here.
The Island of Destiny can be reached via the {oracle} once you are level 8. This trip will help you choose your {profession}!
You will learn everything you need to know about professions once you reach the {Island of Destiny}.
As a premium adventurer you can visit different regions on this island, trade with {Lee'Delle} and much more.
As an adventurer, you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
If you need a torch, go see {Al Dee}'s store.
Oh, I'm sorry, but my grandfather {Obi} doesn't like seeing me waving around with pointy things. He sells weapons himself, just go downstairs!
Are you hungry? Then you should visit {Willie} or {Billy} in the West of town. {Norma} also has yummy stuff! Oh, and you could pick {blueberries} or eat the food some {monsters} carry with them.
{Lily} sells effective health potions and antidote potions against poison.
The big building in the centre of Rookgaard. They have a library, a training centre, a {bank} and the room of the {oracle}. {Seymore} is the teacher there.
King Tibianus is a wise and noble monarch. This island of {Rookgaard} belongs to his kingdom.
Our lovely village will provide shelter for you. Once you are level 8, you can travel to {mainland} and choose a {profession}.
If you want to fight monsters in {dungeons}, you definitely need some good {equipment} such as a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
Just ask me for a {trade} to check out my offers.
Just ask me for a {trade} to see what I buy from you.
To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}.
There are many blueberry bushes in and around this village. Just use them to your liking!
You need to make sure you have some basic {equipment} before you head into dungeons such as the {sewers}.
There is a sewer grate which you can use to enter the sewers just left of this building. Eww, this smell!
I'm fine, thank you.
How can I help you? I can give you general {hints}, information about {citizens} or talk about many other topics. Just ask me!
How can I help you? I can give you general {hints}, information about {citizens} or talk about many other topics. Just ask me!

Norma used to sell {equipment}, but she finally earned enough {money} to fulfil one of her dreams - her own bar!
I never understand what he's talking about.
I'm glad that he's here. He does a great job!
Sometimes, I help Zirella collecting wood. Her old back aches all the time. It's a shame her son Tom doesn't help her.
In Al Dee's shop you will find important general equipment such as {ropes}, {shovels} and torches.
One day, I want to become a brave adventurer like her and leave this town!
Billy can be kind of scary. He swears a lot and doesn't talk to everybody.
Uncle Willie and {Billy} are farmers, which means they are a good place to sell and buy {food}.
He can heal you if you're injured or poisoned.
Did I hear my name somewhere?
I think he's a bit strange, living alone outside this village. How can he dislike to chat with everybody here?
Lee'Delle's shop is on the {premium} side of the village. You should visit it!
I always give my cookies and blueberries to Lily. She loves them! Also, she sells {potions}.
You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8 to find your {destiny}.
He is the local {bank} clerk.
Seymour is a loyal follower of the {king} and a teacher in the {academy}.
I wish he would talk to his mother {Zirella} again. I feel so sorry for her. Anyway, as Tom is a tanner, you can sell leather and fresh corpses to him.
He's one of our reliable guardsmen. Without them, many {monsters} would roam the village of {Rookgaard}!
He's one of our reliable guardsmen. Without them, many {monsters} would roam the village of {Rookgaard}!

send_trade: Here, take a look and choose something nice for you!

entries.text: <clears throat> Get your armor and shields heeeeeeere! Upstairs!
Need some help? Just ask me, I can show you around!
Don't forget to protect yourself with a shield!
Selling the finest armors on Rookgaard!
Don't let these mean monsters hurt you - get better equipment now!

reply: I am Dog Lady.
I can answer simple questions.

greet: Hello.

reply: I am Domizian.
I can answer simple questions.
A general in the army.
He sometimes comes to shop our food.
Weather is good enough to work on the fields.
I dont know.
A generous person.
I am Donald.
He ignores us and we ignore him.
I don't trust sorcerers like you.
Knights always feel superior to us farmers.
Druids are a great help for us, they know much about nature.
It is hard to grow but worth the effort.
My fields are enchanted by the druids and the wheat grows very quickly.
Frodo? He is a friend of mine.
Too noble to care about us.
She has a good soul.
Donald McRonald.
It is my farm, yes.
Who cares?
Sherry is my wife.
The city is to the north.
I sometimes have to bring the wheat there.
King Tibianus is our king.
Hardly know him.
I run a farm, what else?!
A blacksmith, eh?

greet: Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! Why do you disturb me?

reply: One dragon is as bad as the other.

The elves are a curious lot. Even though they distrust humans, it's quite easy to steal from them. To scam them, however, is not that easy. ... Elven laws are also very cruel. They might kill you for a minor occurrence or throw you into Hellgate.

There are many opportunities in Liberty Bay. The poor are eager allies against the rich, and the latter are often VERY rich. Still, the laws are quite strict, and poor or not, the locals are somewhat suspicious towards strangers.
Ankrahmun is great for business despite its cruel laws. It's far too tempting to get all those treasures into your fingers to let the opportunity pass.

The dwarfs aren't easy to deal with. Of course, they have many treasures. Still, dwarfs will hold a grudge against you for decades and they might dedicate their lives to hunt you. ... If an operation in Kazordoon is not getting you a huge profit, it's wiser to leave it.
The city is promising but still a bit underdeveloped. Give it some years to grow and then it's ripe for harvest. For now, we try not to disturb such profitable growth.

Too far away to bother about and not worth the travel. The few people that emigrated from Carlin are not wealthy, neither are the barbarians that live there. ... Not to mention the violence with which they treat strangers that annoy them.

A neat little town for business. A bit too far away for my taste, but as long as you don't mess it up, you can earn a living there. Still, the people there have an odd philosophy, so you might need to adjust your practices somewhat.
My job, uh... what should I say... well, no need to invent something, I guess. I'm the leader of the thieves guild.

We have hardly any business in Carlin. The laws are quite harsh and the city guard in the hands of an overzealous family which makes bribery complicated. ... With the exception of some alcohol smuggle, there is little to be gained there. And even there you have to deal with nasty competitors.
A backwater town, but useful as hiding place when you are wanted for something.
Oswald? He lives near the crossroads.

Venore can be a gold mine but if you aren't careful, you might end up dead in the swamp. There are people in Venore that don't like it if their terrain is trespassed. ... If you steal from the wrong guys, you're dead. If you scam the wrong person, you're dead. If you leave an unfavourable impression on the wrong person, you're dead. ... Well, I guess you got the idea.

Edron is peaceful and many people there live in opulence. So now and then it might be profitable to pay Edron a visit. On the other hand, it's a rather small town and word about your trickeries might spread faster than you'd appreciate.
Isn't this a nasty little place? All that fools, the yelling, the backstabbing, the swindle. I just love it.
They call me Dorian.
My job, uh... what should I say... well, no need to invent something, I guess. I'm the leader of the thieves guild.

greet: Hello there, hmm just... just wait right there, I'll be with you in a second. Just getting this {experiment} done...

reply: I am Dragon Ancestor Spirit.
I can answer simple questions.

greet: Hello.

reply: I am Dread Guardian.
I can answer simple questions.

greet: Ah, a visitor to intimidate. Splendid!
Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Do you feel adventurous? Do you want a weekly {ticket} for the ore wagon system here? You can use it right here to get to the centre of Kazordoon!
Hello.

reply: I am Dulcineo.
I can answer simple questions.

greet: Hi, come closer. Have a look at my wares.
Hiho, fellow knight |PLAYERNAME|!

reply: Would you like to learn {great light} magic spell for 500 gold?
Would you like to learn {wound cleansing} magic spell for free?
Would you like to learn {find person} magic spell for 80 gold?
Would you like to learn {cure poison} magic spell for 150 gold?
Would you like to learn {light} magic spell for free?
I can teach you {healing} spells and {support} spells. I can also tell you which spells are available at your {level}.
My healing spells are: {Cure Poison} and {Wound Cleansing}.
My support spells are: {Find Person}, {Great Light} and {Light}.
For level 13 I have {Great Light} for 500 gold.
For level 10 I have {Cure Poison} for 150 gold.
For level 8 I have {Find Person} for 80 gold, {Light} for free and {Wound Cleansing} for free.
I have spells for level {8}, {10} and {13}.
I'm the highest knight of the dwarfs. I guess you wanna buy spells!
I am Duria Steelbender, daughter of Fire, of the Dragoneaters.
Bah, too much plants and stuff, too few tunnels if you ask me.
Knights are proud of being dwarfs, jawoll.
Heroes are rare in this days, jawoll.
Was there once. Can't handle the crime over there.
Dunno.

greet: Hi!

reply: I am Dwarven Guard.
I can answer simple questions.

greet: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?

entries.text: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.

greet: Who are you? What do you want? You seem too experienced to become my assistant. Please leave.

reply: He was bested in combat, but the hero who killed him, was that humble that he never claimed the fame.
As my assistant you can carry out daily tasks and solve missions for me.
Yes?
What's wrong? Are you afraid to go down there? There's absolutely no reason for that. Me? Erm... my knees, you know. Stairs are such a trial for me. Go on! Secure the cage and calm the demon!
Oh dear. It's all my fault that he is the way he is now. That much I can remember. <sniff>
It's to the far east of here. You can either reach it by ship or walk there, but it's QUITE a walk. I think.
Was that your name...? |PLAYERNAME|? Really? <scratches head> Fine then... hello |PLAYERNAME|!
Yes, you SHOULD be sorry!
I moved away from there for a reason. I just can't remember what the reason was.
What are you thanking me for? <scratches head>
My name is Eclesius. And I'm quite happy that my memory works almost all of the time.
Oh dear. It's all my fault that he is the way he is now. That much I can remember. <sniff>
Hint? What kind of hint?

I have a lot of work to do. I'm a very wise sorcerer, you see. So I'm busy creating magic fields, inventing new spells, reading books, summoning creatures... all very complex. That's why I need assistants for the easy work.
Where did I put that key, erm... I think it's somewhere in my lab. But then again my memory is not the best.

entries.text: I'm looking for a new assistant!
Err, what was it again that I wanted...?
Do come in! Mind the step of the magical door, though.
I'm so sorry... I promise it won't happen again. Problem is, I can't remember where I made the error...
Actually, I STILL prefer inexperienced assistants. They're easier to keep an eye on and don't tend to backstab you.
So much to do, so much to do... uh... where should I start?

reply: Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| gold, child?
Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| gold, child?

Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.

There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.

greet: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Do you need some equipment for your house?

reply: I have {beds}, {chairs}, {containers}, {decoration}, {flowers}, {instruments}, {pillows}, {pottery}, {statues}, {tapestries} and {tables}. Which of those would you like to see?
Fine.
My name is Eddy. I sell furniture.
You mean my specials, don't you?
I have beds, chairs, containers, decoration, flowers, instruments, pillows, pottery, statues, tapestries and tables. Which of those would you like to see?
Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.

send_trade: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?

entries.text: Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.

greet: This world is nothing without poetry, don't you think? It gives us hope, it envokes love. It's inciting and invigorating all the same.

reply: Our world, our home, our very own plane of existence. We have to protect it, mind you. Underneath all the battles, challenges and monsters there still resides a majestic, yet vulnerable being. A mother to us all.
A king and a beggar know more than a king alone... ahem, except for King Tibianus. He most certainly would. All hail King Tibianus etc. etc.
So, you're on a mission. Aren't we all? A quest to savour the important moments, the valuable memories? To fight for love and happiness, heroically and against all odds? Yes, we are indeed.
So, you're on a mission. Aren't we all? A quest to savour the important moments, the valuable memories? To fight for love and happiness, heroically and against all odds? Yes, we are indeed.
Rather a calling. The weight of words is something not easily lifted by some, yet it can be a mighty weapon to others. ...

entries.text: Orshabaal was out of his maze to make us suffer for many days. In Calmera, a knight with blue beard from his hideout appeared. He fought bravely supported by mages, the demon ran and is gone for ages.

A knight from Guardia needed Chayenne's key. His friend dropped the item on the floor, hoping no one would see. But, at the same moment, a man crossed their way and all the knight's dreams faded away.
A knight from Candia was dining at Frodo's hut, devouring plates full of meat and whatnot. Suddenly, he was called to fight. He wanted to put his armor on but it was too tight.
The druid entered a Premian pyramid intent on the kill, 'Oh, that djinn will die, it will!' Down and up the stairs she hopped like a cat... When, Oops! She moved the wrong way, and died a drunk rat.
Hoping to find a strange orc in his spawn, a Zaneran knight logged on before dawn. A sudden heart attack left him surprised as Sam's old backpack he had recognised.
The world I shall save', an Olympian knight proclaimed! But from a visit to the bar he could not abstain! He woke up in pain, it all was in vain. From Venorian beer he will forever refrain.
During the dark and scary night, when others sleep he goes to fight, banishing demons, that feels right, purging the evil on the sight, fearlessly waiting for daylight, Zeluna's bravest elite knight.
A druid from Celesta once talked with a girl, he even bought her a necklace with a huge white pearl. Every time he went home, without money and fame, I guess this girl is cursed, Aruda is the name.

A story of a knight untold, on Rowana the dice she rolled. She lured players from afar. Who could resist a shining star? She promised gold and many items, then stole their heart with cunning kindness.
Do you think it's just a game? Don't you fear the dragon's flame? If you are as brave as bright, if you do not stray from fight, you may want to hear tonight, the tale of Guardia's lonely knight.
For a knight from Yanara 10,000 gold were a lot. So he ventured with a team into the desert to win that pot. He solved all the riddles, strongly willed. But on his journey home he sadly was killed.
A great mage from Celesta went dungeon down deep, he was very brave but his wand was cheap. Among white skeletons one of them was red. Last what he saw were the words: 'You are dead!'
A young sorcerer born and raised on Astera when dragons were scary, it was that kind of era. Walking all the way to the city of Venore, he stole from the dwarven bridge nothing less than an iron ore.
A druid from Eternia just bought his first boots of haste, to finally have his leather boots replaced. Catching a backpack of fish was now his dream, but he ended up swinging his new boots upstream.
A sorcerer from Efidia took his horse and got it saddled, and set out for battle. His horse lost control and threw him into a hole. Now his team lost all hope, because he forgot to bring a rope.
A knight in Guardia was feeling bored. He wanted to show a dragon lord the taste of his new carlin sword. To its lair then he did go. But before he saw his foe, he met his end by a one hit K.O.
On Secura a confident knight levelled to main, 840 rats he had slain. 'I am going to kill dragons,' he said while pounding his breastplate. The next thing he saw was: 'You have met a sad fate.'
One morning frosty fresh and nice, a knight was fishing on the ice. Catching some pikes for soup, but a dire penguin ate his loot. His angry wife said in the house: Now whole Beneva will laugh at us!
A paladin slaying dragons on Antica's soil, when a lord charges on to make the adventurer's blood boil. It puts up a strong fight, but to no avail. It gets slain and drops a dragon scale mail!
Through Rookgaard's sewer there swarmed no fewer than a hundred screeching rats. Wading through mud, and covered in blood, two young men fought back-to-back. To Trimera's end; a knight, and a friend.

farewell: Come back whenever you're in need of wisdom.
greet: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|! How nice of you to visit an old man like me.

reply: I gather wisdom and knowledge. I am also an astrologer.
This brotherhood was an secret society of necromancers and followers of purest evil. They were vanquished long ago by their arch enemies, the Nightmare Knights.

The Triangle of Terror is a cabal of three archdemons that have put aside their quarrels to establish some power in the shadows of the Ruthless Seven. Although they are all very mighty demons, compared to one of the seven, they appear weak ... So they try not to interfere much with the doings of the seven and look for power elsewhere. Their members are Morgaroth, the schemer, Ghazbaran, the lord of blades and Zoralurk, the demon with the thousand faces.
The Nightmare Knights were an ancient order dedicated to fight evil. They were guided by prophetic dreams. The order ceased to exist after their war against the Brotherhood of Bones.
Though they possess only a few charges, stone skin amulets are sought after because they offer complete protection from physical damage.
Although some priests claim that a war was fought on behalf of the gods, it seems more likely that this was kind of a civil war between the Djinn of good and the Djinn of evil.
There is no such thing, believe me. The dead don't care for taste.
These amulets are a more powerful version of the elven amulets. They were created by a race long gone from this plane, and offer significant protection against every kind of damage.
These amulets protect you against harm from energy attacks and magic fields.

This chalice was a tool of the gods which they created to make their task to create life easier. Zathroth who lacked the knowledge of creation stole that chalice and used it to spawn his evil minions.

The overlords of the demonkind are more powerful than even demonlords are. They are nearly indestructible. Armoured with layers of impenetrable hide and endowed with awesome magical power, demon overlords are true incarnation of death.
An infernal place in which the nightmare knights created a base to fight the minions of evil. It was lost when the Ruthless Seven conquered it.
Somewhere in the Plains of Havoc, where the Necromant King was defeated, lies the secret entrance to the Pits of Inferno.
The core piece of these amulets is a little dragon scale. It protects you to some extent against fire damage.
This charm, feared and despised by the undead, protects your lifeforce from life-draining powers.
These powerful amulets are usually blessed by some god. They offer additional armour and protection.
This ring increases the rate with which you heal your physical wounds.
They are more than a myth, they are a horrible reality. It is possible that they still reside in the pits of inferno.
These amulets were created and enchanted by powerful magicians and priests. They protect both body and soul from the losses caused by the trauma of death.

The so-called singing steel causes a constant humming while it is forged. It is said this was a sign of its absorbing magic powers in the process, and it was presumably easy to enchant. ... Sadly, the secret where to mine or how to create this ore has been lost in the course of time.
The Paradox Tower was home of a mighty but mad wizard. It is said that only the cunning and mad can brave the tests of that tower to gain its treasures.
This human showed no fear and did not yield under torture. They could bend him, but they never managed to break him. Impressed by this mortal, Gabel talked to him and learned about his philosophy.

The legendary banshee queen is incredibly old and likely next to invincible. She's rumoured to have her lair in the deepest caverns of the ghostlands. She seems to be more likely to talk than her sisters, but is certainly even more evil than them.
Behind the mountain lies a land of great danger.
Some creatures are able to attack your magic power rather than your lifeforce. This amulet bestows some protection against those attacks.
This amulet purifies your blood. It will reduce the damage caused by poison.

The Djinn were the result of his first attempts. They were powerful and quite evil, but not as evil as Zathroth wished and quite independent in their thinking. Finally he discarded them and decided his second try would become his masterpiece.
A shame he's gone. He could have become somewhat of a tourist magnet.
These ancient elven artefacts are highly enchanted and grant some protection against any form of damage.
This is the metal of 'evil', the hell-forged iron no ordinary flames can melt. It is rumoured to be harvested in hell from iron rocks in which damned souls were imprisoned.
I am fine, thank you.

Zathroth channelled all the hatred and foulness he could muster. He added the burning rage of his son Blog and mixed it with fire. The energy that was released destroyed the chalice, but Zathroth had succeeded in creating the first demon.
The gods created the vortex to guide powerful souls to our world so they might join the battle for creation.
Although lovely, the city of the elves lacks the grace and the vibrance of the elven cities of old. The elves are still working on improvement of their settlement.
The elves of Shadowthorn are hosile to intruders. Their Kuridai leaders practise some sinister cults and the other castes are more their minions then their equals.
Magic items are numerous. If you would like some details, please ask me about a specific item.
These rings were created by an ancient, long since forgotten race. It is said they valued secrecy above all. They used these magic rings to make themselves invisible.
There are several kinds of magic metals in our world, the best known are called Mesh Kaha Rogh, Za'Kalortith, Uth'Byth, Uth'Morc, Uth'Amon, Uth'Maer, Uth'Doon, and Zatragil.
The human whom the Djinn had caught was none other but Daraman. The mighty Gabel was intrigued by his philosophy and changed his ways according to Daraman's teachings.

The archdemons are few, and extremely rare. And a good thing, too, for they are the rulers of the demon race. They are vain and powerhungry creatures who tend to form only small cabals and fight each other instead of allying against creation.

The ancient structures that were found deep beneath the ghostlands were built by an unkown race for an unknown purpose. It's quite certain that, whatever they were once used for, they now cause madness and ghost sightings in the surrounding area.
The underground city of the minotaurs can be reached through a dangerous passage from the old temple.
In the old days the underground temple was built for the glory of Banor after a victory over the orcish hordes. It is now an abandoned and dreary place overrun by rotworms.
These rings were created by the sorcerers' guilds of old. They temporarily provide their wielders with a shield of magic.
Well, just ask me about anything that might be of interest. We will see if I can help you.

In the war of the Djinn citys were levelled, lands were cursed and islands sunk. Finally, Malor was caught and imprisoned in an enchanted bottle. His followers fled this plane, while the good djinn laid to rest to recover their strength.

The teachings of asceticism, inner peace and ascension appealed to the Djinn, although in the beginning this was probably only because of his vanity and his greed for divinity. However, Malor and his followers opposed him.

Morgaroth belongs to the cabal Triangle of Terror. He usually has minions to do his work rather than doing it himself. Although sometimes he enters our world in person to inspire the fear his cabal is built upon.
Ghazbaran is a member of the demonic cabal Triangle of Terror. He likes the physical challenge and combat as much as the pain and death he inflicts.

Orshabaal is one of the many servants of the Ruthless Seven. By far weaker than his masters, he seems to have developed some kind of inferiority complex which he tries to compensate by raiding our world and slaying as many innocents as he can.
How could they try to understand death, if they don't care to understand life?
The ancient fortress city of the dwarfs was carved into the mountain known as 'The Big Old One'. It is quite hidden and heavily guarded to withstand any assault.
It was on Rookgaard where the soul vortex appeared. The Thaian kingdom holds an outpost there to protect the vortex and to guide the newly-arrived souls.
This kind of ring will increase your skill when fighting with bare hands.
This ring will give you limited protection against any kind of damage.
This ring will increase your skill when wielding swords.
The ancient dwarven kings forged it using magic metal , which they took from cyclopses who found it in the heart of a fallen star.
Mages claim to be wise, but how wise can it be to sacrifice your life to books and scrolls and not for the people?
The town of Darashia is built around one of the few sweet water supplies of Darama. It is famous for its sand wasp honey and its sandworm stew.
Zoralurk is said to be a member of the demon cabal called Triangle of Terror. She is rumoured to wander the lands in many disguises, poisoning the body and minds of people by word or deed.
The Abdaisim are what humans would call 'independent elves'. They take shelter wherever they might find it, are wanderers and explorers. They only keep loose contact with the elven society.
One could call the Deraisim the scouts and rangers of elvenkind. Although all elves are formidable in that area, the Deraisim excel them all.

Zathroth is the dark twin of Uman. They are one and they are two separate entities. We mortals can't really grasp this concept. He is the patron of dark magic and even darker secrets, the lust for dominance through cunning, and manipulation.
This ring will increase your skill when wielding a club weapon.
These rings improve your regenerative powers, accelerating the recovery of both your mana and your lifeforce.
This steel absorbs magic. While it is of inferior quality compared to ordinary steel, its absorbing qualities make it important though.
What makes this black steel exceptional is its lightness and peculiar property of lacking the common steel 'noise'. It is also called 'silent steel' or 'thief's steel' for this reason.
The luminescent brightsteel is used for artwork mainly. In ancient times, items of great magic power were crafted using brightsteel. Those crafts were lost with the races who held the secret to them.
The dwarfs call it heartiron and claim it is part of the heart of The Big Old One. Therefore, they hold it sacred and its use is limited and regulated.
The dwarven high steel is relatively common but expensive and still hard to come by. The elite dwarven weaponry and armours are made of Uth'Doon.
The so-called dreamsilver is a legendary metal. Almost everything we know about it are rumours only.
A paladin is more than just a knight armed with a bow and some spells, though most seem to be unaware of that fact.
As far as I can tell, this creature is not fond of cheaters and won't allow them to pass his tests.
Dungeons are a place of danger, not of joy. Keep that in mind on your travels.
Man or monster, the difference is often just a matter of hides and scales.

Daraman was a sage with ambition, that's for sure. His philosophy centred around the idea that by controlling yourself you could improve yourself. The closer you are coming to perfection, the closer you are to ascending to divinity.
The banshees are creatures that grief and despair turned into vengeful spirits after their death. Their wail is deadly, and they draw new strength from the pain and fear of others.
Endulos was not a great warrior, but a man of wit and genius. After many of his brethren of the Nightmare Knights had fallen prey to the beast, he came up with a cunning plan to end this threat.
The Necromant King. He is dead forever, and that is the nicest thing I can say about him. May he rot in his tomb.

The small but strong dwarves are tireless workers and fierce warriors. They are familiar with several crafts and mastered most of them. In our days their smithing skills are rivalled only by those of the cyclopses.

The Kuridai are the craftsmen and warriors of elvenkind. They are always moving, always scheming. They are the most aggressive elves and distrust outsiders. An outsider might be each non-Kuridai to them.
Its said that those elves were the masters of the dreams. Which many consider a special brand of magic. They seem to have vanished from the face of Tibia ages ago, however, and their fate is unknown.

Cyclopses are seen as the smiths of Blog, whom they call 'the ragehammer' or 'ragehammerer'. Indeed their skills create mostly crude and nasty-looking weapons and armor, but which are incredibly effective nonetheless.
This ring will increase your skill when wielding any kind of axe.
That's me, but don't worry about remembering my name. I will forget your name as well.
Rumours are an unsafe path to follow.
Rumours are an unsafe path to follow.
Those who live by the sword get shot by those who don't.
Knights could be artists, but tend to become sellswords.
Knights could be artists, but tend to become sellswords.
Druids seek enlightenment in nature, but they often just find what they brought with them.
Mages claim to be wise, but how wise can it be to sacrifice your life to books and scrolls and not for the people?
Who laughs last, thinks slowest.
A strong wall may protect from an assault, but what will protect you from the enemy within?
The dreaded town of Drefia was once a haven for heretics, necromancers and demon worshippers. Its was destroyed in the war of the Djinn.
The desert lands of Darama are harsh and unforgiving. Therefore Daraman led his people there to found a new community based upon his teachings.
There are at least five demonic cabals of archdemons. The ruthless seven are the most prominent and powerful.
Whatever the original meaning of that underground complex was, it is now like an open wound in the nearby lands, spreading madness and attracting all kinds of ghosts and apparitions.

As far as we know, once a terrible beast roamed the lands we now call the Plains of Havoc. It was so fierce that no one dared to even dream about killing it. It was finally tricked by the knight Endulos.
A city in the far north. It separated itself from the Thaian kingdom about 100 years ago. Now it is ruled by a dynasty of queens.
Venore is a centre of commerce and trade. Its ambitious trade barons are nominally subjects of the Thaian kingdom.
The elven society is dividded into certain castes, the cenath, the kuridai, the deraisim, the abdaisim and the legendary teshial.
The Cenath favour magic above all other. They are the keepers of elven lore and wisdom. They are responsible for the astounding feats of druidic magic the elves are capable of.
I believe that true love is stronger than all magic, don't you agree?
A paladin is more than just a knight armed with a bow and some spells, though most seem to be unaware of that fact.
Druids seek enlightenment in nature, but they often just find what they brought with them.
Sewers are sometimes the safer ways to get where you want to go.

Legend has it that the Djinn were created by Zathroth by using the stolen chalice of life. They roamed the world for Aeons causing strife and despair until Gabel, one of their lords, met a very special human.

Malor was second in power only to Gabel and his followers among the Djinn were many. It was not easy for the evil Djinn to change their ways, and many preferred to follow Malor instead of Gabel. In the end a civil war erupted.
Gabel was the most powerful among the Djinn lords. He was cruel and merciless, until one day his minions brought a certain human to him whom they had captured and tortured.
Demons are the servants of evil. More or less devoted servers of Zathroth they cause strife and havoc wherever they appear. Their masters are known as Demonlords, Demon Overlords and Archdemons.
If Tibia is a fallen god, does that makes us the maggots crawling on it?
Edron is the latest colony of the Thaian kingdom. However, structures of an earlier colonisation have been found. We cannot tell if those inhabitants were human or of any other known race.
Thais is the capital of an ancient human kingdom. Once its rule was more or less undisputed. In the years the strength of the Thaian kingdom eroded by different events.

The small but strong dwarves are tireless workers and fierce warriors. They are familiar with several crafts and mastered most of them. In our days their smithing skills are rivalled only by those of the cyclopses.
I am Edowir, but don't worry about remembering my name. I will forget your name as well.
Time is a pillar and our lives wind around it like vines.
Who laughs last, thinks slowest.
Who laughs last, thinks slowest.
Kings are children adorned with crowns.
I think you are referring to the beast Hugo that is said to still haunt the Plains of Havoc. The legends which tell of this creature are ancient and almost forgotten.
He lured Hugo into a trap. Bound by roots and stones charged with powerful magic he could not move anymore. Now, the beast lies trapped in a hidden cave for all eternity.
The legends tell us that the Nightmare Knights trapped it beneath one of their fortresses, or rather that they built a fortress on top of his eternal prison.

Uman is the light twin of Zathroth. Their unity and separation at once is a concept we cannot hope to grasp. He is the patron of light magic, the knowledge that benefits all and brings progress to the society.
Blog is the god of rage and fierce battle. He's also the patron of power, although a power to oppress and bully others around. He is the son of Zathroth and one of the Tibian suns.
Growing old is mandatory, growing up is optional.
Growing old is mandatory, growing up is optional.
Learn about the gods to learn from the gods.

entries.text: I'm just an old man, but I know a lot about Tibia.

walkaway: Come back whenever you're in need of wisdom.

greet: Welcome to Edron Furniture Store, |PLAYERNAME|.

reply: Well, as you can see, I sell furniture. Ask me for a {trade} if you're interested to see my wares.

send_trade: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?

entries.text: Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.

greet: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?

entries.text: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.
