The icy father. We know him all too well, am I right boys? He has claimed so many old friends in all those years. So many.

greet: Hello, worshiper of the Astral Shapers! Welcome to the temple! While you are here to pay tribute, you can also learn something about the ancient art of imbuing.

reply: My {father}, can you tell me if he's alright?
Alright then, you are very welcome to explore the temple!
My name is Ivalisse.
There is always time to make a change.
Besides my various {duties} in the temple, I also take care of visitors. Well, I would but right now I can't get my mind of how my {father}'s doing. I am sorry.
I help linking the portals of this temple to other ancient sites of the {Astral Shapers}.
I help linking the portals of this temple to other ancient sites of the {Astral Shapers}.
As far as we know today, the Astral Shapers are an ancient, very advanced race of master artisans.
I hope he's alright... ah, nevermind.
I don't really know what you're talking about, sorry.

reply: I am Ivora.
I can answer simple questions.

greet: Feel welcome to my gem store, |PLAYERNAME|.

greet: Hello, Sir |PLAYERNAME|. Where can I {sail} you today?

reply: My name is Jack Fate from the Royal Tibia Line.
I'm the captain of this - well, wreck. Argh.
I'm the captain of this - well, wreck. Argh
This is where we are... the volcano island Goroma. There are many rumours about this place.
I need your help in a matter of utmost {urgency}.
The situation is complicated and it's even hard to say where to {start} best, just to describe it to you.
You see, several incidents in history can be traced back to a single {source}.
Things get murkier the further you go down in history, but that's not even necessary. Even today we can discern a certain pattern in recent {events}.
Well, in Rathleton there was an individual at work, looking for some ancient artefact of power. ...
To cover its escape the creature left another creature, known as the ravager to cover his tracks. But there is {more}.
Only recently someone was trying to manipulate the elven dream courts into releasing a monstrosity of nightmares, probably planning to control or recruit this creature. ....
But those incidents were just some of {many}.
The recent rise of lycanthropy, the robbery of certain forbidden arcane texts and the vanishing of at least three dangerous individuals, targeted by the inquisition are just the tip of the {iceberg}.
There is a scheming going on behind the scenes. Powerful good people were corrupted. Evil-doers got backup and resources from a hidden ally. ...
Powerful malignant creatures, gathering their kind under their banner and so much more. These things are not happening by chance. There is a pattern, a guiding {hand}.
This outside force is moving behind the scenes since ages. Our research suggests that this force probably even {predates} the rise of humanity.

Well, we are sure that the puppeteer behind all these events is an organisation. So old that even its name, the Shiron'Fal, has lost its meaning, because the {language} it originates from is long dead.
It has a rather complex meaning and as far as we can tell it translates to 'army of those who are many, dedicated to the ultimate time of mayhem and despair'. ...
Other, more handy names are army of the last battlefield, army of the last days, legion of mayhem, dread legion or simply the {legion}.
We know little for sure. You can look into our books to see some of our sources. But most are vague and some even contradictory. ...
To summarise what we know, let me tell you this: The Shiron'Fal is an extremely old organisation. It seeks to accumulate power for some unknown but certainly sinister {goal}.

For this purpose, the members gather knowledge, artefacts and powerful individuals. The members are formidable at certain fields of expertise. They are cunning and powerful and act with no regard for others, with no remorse or mercy. ...
As they are doing this since ages, they must have acquired tremendous powers and knowledge. Their members often operate alone but are usually well funded with the necessary resources. ...
Whatever their endgame might be, each of their operations pose a grave danger to the whole world and have to be {stopped}.
Here is where you come into play. We could identify the most recent plot of the Shiron'Fal and already had some {clashes}.
In our efforts to hinder their plot, we achieved mixed results at best. But now things are escalating fast and we have to {hurry}.
Our resources are already stretched thin, so we need your help with the most recent {problem}.
The legion tries to use a new form of twisted rituals to raise the bodies of well-known {knights}.
The knights they aim at were tainted in life by their actions or happenstance. ...
This leaves their bodies vulnerable to their special breed of necromancy that would raise them as powerful {lich}-knights.
These powerful undead were a terrible threat on their own but it seems even they are just part of some larger {scheme} that we cannot make out yet.
We are still working feverishly to uncover their goals but for now more imminent {threats} are at hand.
Death cultists of the Shiron'Fal are trying to locate the bodies of fallen knights and raise them in blasphemous {rituals}.
The churches of the gods worked hand in hand to supply us with the means to {purge} the graves of those knights.
Reaching the graves will not be without danger and if you encounter the death cultists you will have to fight them. Even worse, they might have even succeeded in some cases. ...
As a newly risen lich-knight is not able to leave the site of its resurrection for some time, you might have to fight some of them. ...
Let us pray that you never come too {late} or else some of the fiends might be able to leave their crypts.

We have located twelve graves that have to be secured: In the old northern Edron graveyard, in the dark cathedral of the plains of havoc, in the ghostlands, on Cormaya, Somewhere in the Femor Hills, on Vengoth, ...

in the graveyard of Darashia, in the old temple north of Thais, at the entrance to the orcland, one is on the southern ice islands, in a mountain on Kilmaresh, one on an island north-east of Ankrahmun.

reply: This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ...
It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ...

Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?

There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.

greet: Ho matey.

Greetings. A warning straight ahead: I don't like loiterin'. If you're not here to {help} us, you're here to waste my time. Which I consider loiterin'. Now, try and prove your {worth} to our alliance. ...

I have sealed some of the areas far too dangerous for anyone to enter. If you can prove you're capable, you'll get an opportunity to help destroy the weird machines, pumping lava into the caves leading to the most dangerous enemies.

reply: Well, the biggest problem we need to address are the ever charging {subterraneans} around here. And on top of that, there's the threat of the Lost, who quite made themselves at {home} in these parts.

Maintainin' this whole operation, the dwarven involvement 'course. Don't know about them gnomes but if I ain't gettin' those dwarves in line, there'll be chaos down here. I also oversee the {defences} and {counterattacks}.
The attacks of the enemy forces are fierce but we hold our ground. ...
I'd love to face one of their generals in combat but as their masters they cowardly hide far behind enemy lines and I have other duties to fulfil. ...
I envy you for the chance to thrust into the heart of the enemy, locking weapons with their jaws... or whatever... and see the fear in their eyes when they recognise they were bested.
I welcome a fine battle as any dwarf worth his beard should do. As long as it's a battle against something I can hit with my trusty axe. ...
But here the true {enemy} eludes us. We fight wave after wave of their lackeys and if the gnomes are right the true enemy is up to something far more sinister.
I have no idea what kind of creeps are behind all this. Even the gnomes don't and they have handled that stuff way more often. ...

But even if we knew nothing more about them, the fact alone that they employ the help of those mockeries of all things dwarfish, marks them as an enemy of the dwarves and it's our obligation to annihilate them.
Klom Stonecutter's the name.

How can I help you? If you like to buy something, just ask me for a {trade}. We can also chat about {Tibia}. Or, I could give you general {hints} about the game.
You definitely need a good {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}. Also, you should never leave for a {dungeon} without {rope}, {shovel} and {torch}.
I'm in tune with myself and with nature. Thank you.
I'm a {druid}, bound to the spirit of nature. My {potions} will help you if you feel bad. I also buy {blueberries} and {cookies}. Just ask me for a {trade}.
My name is Lily, like the flower. It also stands for purity, just like my {potions} are!
It's about |TIME|. But does it really matter? Don't rush yourself and enjoy all these little moments.
It's wise to store most of your gold at the bank below the academy. It's safer that way.
If you tell me the name of a citizen, I'll tell you what I know about him or her.
Antidote potions will cure {poisoning}. They also have a lovely {blueberry} taste. You only need them when you get poisoned deep down in a dungeon, else just go to the {temple} for a free heal!
Some creatures like snakes or poison spiders can poison you. That will diminish your health over a certain amount of time, so be careful when dealing with those creatures!
Being a druid is a wonderful profession. You control the forces of nature and can heal others.
There are many shops around here which are owned by local {citizens}.
The temple is just to the right. You can get a healing for free there if you are badly injured or poisoned.
Tibia is our beautiful world, created by the gods. Being a {druid}, I'm a worshipper of {Crunor}.
Crunor is the great lord of trees and the creator of all plants. Despite what some people believe, he didn't create the {monsters}, though.
Oh, I'm sorry honey, I don't sell food. If you are hungry, visit one of the farmers {Billy} and {Willie}. I buy {blueberries} and {cookies}, though.
If you purchase premium time for your account, this opens up a lot of possibilities. ...
For example, you will be able to travel off the mainland, ride a mount and benefit from offline training as well as having more outfits and magic spells to choose from.
I can offer you homemade {antidote} potions and small {health} potions. Ask me for a {trade} if you like to see them.
Health potions will heal you for about 75 hit points. It can't hurt to carry one with you, just in case.
I think Tibia would be a better place without authorities who lead others to war. Can't we just all live in peace?
The academy is the big stone building in the town centre. If you're ready to leave Rookgaard, go there to see the {oracle}.
Well, in this village and its surroundings you can {train} your skills until you are level 8. Then you should see the {oracle} and head to the {main} continent.
To train your skills, simply help us {fighting} monsters.
If you want to fight monsters, you should get better {equipment} from the {merchants}. You should also talk to one of the bridge {guards} to find suitable monsters for you.
To view the offers of a merchant, simply talk to him or her and ask for a {trade}. They will gladly show you their offers and also the things they buy from you.
The main continent is huge! The gods of Tibia created everything from great seas, deep jungles and large deserts.
Sadly, our little village of {Rookgaard} is invaded by monsters. From the {dungeons} they creep to the surface and attack the city. We always need adventurers helping us to {fight} them.
If you are looking for weapons, you should visit {Obi}'s shop east of here. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
Armors? Best buy them at {Dixi}'s little counter, just upstairs from {Obi}'s shop. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
Shields? Best buy them at {Dixi}'s little counter, just upstairs from {Obi}'s shop. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.
If you need information about the dungeons here, you should talk to one of the bridge {guards}. They will show you where to go.
Our bridge guards are {Dallheim} and {Zerbrus}. You can find Dallheim if you follow the path to the right, then turn north at the {temple}.
Yum, cookies! If you have some for me, just ask me for a trade.
Earn gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up what they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
Earn gold by fighting {monsters} and picking up what they carry. Sell it to {merchants} to make profit!
I will pay you 5 gold for every empty vial and potion flask. Just ask me for a {trade}.
I will pay you 5 gold for every empty vial and potion flask. Just ask me for a {trade}.

You best buy such equipment at {Al Dee}'s store in the North of the village. Or, if you have a {premium} account, go to {Lee'Delle} for better offers.

Oh yes, I love cookies! Will you accept 1 gold for it?
Oh, do you have blueberries for sale? I need them for my {antidote potion}. I give you 1 gold for 5 of them, yes?
Oh, do you have blueberries for sale? I need them for my {antidote potion}. I give you 1 gold for 5 of them, yes?
Oh, do you have blueberries for sale? I need them for my {antidote potion}. I give you 1 gold for 5 of them, yes?
He sells {weapons}. His shop is east of here.
I don't know what to think about all this new bar. {Rookgaard} needs a little peace!
He used to help me gather blueberries. Then, one day, he suddenly stopped comming here. They say he went a little out of his mind.
We tried everything to fight that cockroach plague in his cellar, but natural anti-bug potions simply won't help. I guess those roaches need to be fought with stronger weapons.
That poor old woman. I wish I could help her.
Best tool shop in town, if you ask me.
I heard that she's recovering below the academy. She has been on an exciting expedition. I haven't talked to her yet, though.
Visiting Cipfried in the {temple} is a good idea if you are injured or poisoned. He can heal you.
She's {Obi}'s granddaughter and deals with {armors} and {shields}, just upstairs from Obi's shop.
Hyacinth also sells small health potions. He lives outside the village, in a hidden place.
If you are a {premium} adventurer, you should check out {Lee'Delle's} shop. She lives in the western part of town, just across the bridge.
Yes?
You can find the oracle on the top floor of the {academy}, just above {Seymour}. Go there when you are level 8 to reach more areas of {Tibia}.
He takes care of the {bank}, keeping our money safe.
Seymour is a teacher running the {academy}. He has many important {information} about Tibia.
He's the local tanner. You could try selling fresh corpses or leather to him.
He is a great warrior. He can also tell you much about {monsters} and {dungeons} on this island.
He is a great warrior. He can also tell you much about {monsters} and {dungeons} on this island.
He's a farmer and sells {food}. Food will help you regain health when you are injured. Many {monsters} also carry food with them.
He's a farmer and sells {food}. Food will help you regain health when you are injured. Many {monsters} also carry food with them.

send_trade: Of course, just browse through my offers. If you buy a potion, don't forget that there's a {deposit} of 5 gold on the empty flask.

entries.text: Are you injured or poisoned? Get your potions here! All natural, no artificial ingredients!
Hey you, over there! Let's have a little chat, shall we?
Oh, just in case you are looking for the marketplace and dungeons, just follow the path to the east.
Anyone got some cookies for me?
Do you need help? Just ask me about anything you'd like to know!
I'm buying all of your blueberries for my famous blueberry juice!

greet: I'd rather be left in {peace}. Keep it short.
Hey there. I need your help urgently, we have to {save} Targuna!

reply: It's Lizzie, with double z.
That's the name, I bet you are here for the lizards.
Well, short and simple - I research many types of lizards.

What a beautiful place it has become over the years. Especially after we constructed more buildings and opened more stores and offices, in order to make sure that every visitor has their need fulfilled.

She's done quite the traveling to get here, if I remember correctly she started her journey somewhere in Ankrahmun, had to deal with something in Svargrond and ended up here on Targuna. What a journey!
The boat on the south side of this island can bring you to Thais and back to Targuna. You should talk to the Captain whenever you're ready for the Tibian Mainland.
We have a few main travel options here, you can travel with Captain Indigo to Thais or use the turtle to travel to Aragonia. Though I keep forgetting the turtle's name ... What was it again, arrg!
What turtle? I do research on lizards.
That pirate island?! I wouldn't want to mess with them, no thank you!
Nothing in this world will bring me close to any of these dangerous pirates on Aragonia. But if we're talking about Sterling, well then I have another opinion ...
He's great, I always enjoyed the after hours while fishing on the beach in the south. You can really talk about a lot with him, he's always open for adventures.
At the bank you can deposit your well earned money, withdraw from your already existing fortune and even make transactions for other things in the tibian world.
Adrian has been doing all of our finances for quite some time now. The bank can be found right next to us, you can spot it easily with the sign next to it.
Aurelia is taking care of all supplies that come in on a regular basis from Thais. She sells these in her shop south of the depot.
The shop is right here, you can resupply and freshen up before heading into battle, Aurelia will take care of all these needs.
Our mayor Camilla can be found in the upper levels of the depot. Once you're done with my mission you can make a report on my research and your findings.
The mayor was elected unanimously, Camilla does such a great job of representing our island and us as citizens.
Isn't she the imbuement expert?! I heard she made quite the fortune with that and then settled down here on Targuna. I bet she has a lot to tell.
Leonora runs the post office here in Targuna. Everything related to parcels and letters can be done in the post office.
If there's ever a need to send a letter or a parcel, Leonora has you covered. Her office is in the northern part of the island.
Who? I don't know anybody of that name ...

greet: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?

entries.text: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Tibian Bank before you head out for adventure.

greet: Be greeted, dear traveller.

reply: Maybe another time.

Maybe another time.
Do you seek a passage to the centre of Port Hope for |TRAVELCOST|?
Maybe another time.
Do you seek a passage to Darama for |TRAVELCOST|?
Maybe another time.
Do you seek a passage to the centre of Port Hope for |TRAVELCOST|?
I heard he is some scary magician or so.
I can travel you to west, centre, darama, chor or banuta.
You can activate this spell by pointing your index finger in the direction of your enemy, conjure the power of your rune and shoot the magic missiles in your enemy's body.
Remember the spell where you only got to wave your hand? Well, wave it twice and shoot a heavy magic missile at your enemy. This spell will create a rune with five charges.
A strong blast of fire wounds the opponent you point at, and the adjacent squares.
A lightning bolt strikes the point you look at.
A good one to scare children. You can change your appearance to any monster. You can be as handsome as a ghoul!
It's told that some hero killed him and absorbed his power.
This spell is able to cure almost every injury at a higher cost than the other healing spells.
This spell will cure more wounds or greater ones at once. This is of course more 'mana intensive', but everybody will sooner or later get in a situation where mana is nothing - compared to life.
This one gives you the ability to summon monsters that aid you in your battles.
Imagine scaling the normal fireball by two and raising the fire temperature.
I praise my master Alatar.
The mystic crystal should be able to resurrect fresh corpses..
The paths to the next temple are long. Even in Tibia. So learn this spell, and be able to heal yourself during your travels. This spell will only cure small wounds, but it is pretty helpful.
Trapped again between fire, poison and energy fields? This spell will give you the ability to destruct the fields, so you can pass safely.
This spell will create a single field of poisonous gas. Cast it on a creature you were not able to arrange a peace treaty with. If it has no antidote, watch what could happen if you forget yours.
This one will create a field of energy. Everyone stepping in will be struck from lightning. This field will not last as long as poison or fire fields, but it is more deadly.
Well, mages are more bookworms than sportsmen, and as such often neglect their physical fitness. In ancient tomes lies the power to use mana as an equivalent to life. So use this spell to survive.
The best spell for deciding a battle within seconds. The spell tries to interrupt the opponents heart beat, leading to his instant death in most cases.
If you search someone, this spell will give you an idea of the direction you must head. You will not be able to see, whether he is below or above you.
With this one you can create a huge wall of poisonous gas. Many monsters will be too scared to pass the wall and if they do, they will choke from nausea.
Attracts lightning bolts from the sky, to form a giant wall, seriously damaging everyone who passes.
Shoots a triangular bundle of lightning bolts in the direction you look.
This spell acts similar to the 'poison field' spell, except that you create fire instead of poisonous gas. Don't enter it yourself or you will realize why it is said that 'fire eats everything'.
A ray of energy will strike everyone in your current direction
He lived in a lonely house in the south eastern part of Tibia beyond the mountains.
Turn to you opponent and release the forces of nature with a whisper of your voice. A triangle of fire will burn all persons in your view, so take care, in which direction you look!
With a snip of your finger you can cover the floor with a burning carpet that keeps on burning for a while.
As the poison wall, this spell creates an even larger wall of fire, burning everyone who passes.
A strong blast of fire wounds the opponent you point at, and the adjacent squares.
This spell drains the colors out of you body, making yourself invisible for an hour or two.
This spell sucks the venom out of your veins, that some enemy might have injected.
A perfect symbiosis of fire and wind. More is not to be said about this spell. Use this fireball as a warning or as your defence, but don't burn your fingers.
With a snip of your finger you can cover the floor with a burning carpet that keeps on burning for a while.
As the poison wall, this spell creates an even larger wall of fire, burning everyone who passes.
Which is the spell you need the formula to?
Well, he was my great master. He taught me all these fantastic things about magic. I really miss him.
He runs his magic shop in the southwest of the city. He sells runes and spells and helps you, if you want to become a sorcerer.
Although your attack spells get stronger with your usage of magic, real power is gained by finding strategies to properly use your magic abilities.
He runs a magic shop in the main road.
I could tell you much about all sorcerer spells, but you won't understand it. Anyway, feel free to ask me.
Oh, I can tell you a lot about all sorcerer spells. Feel free to ask me about the spell name or the formula to cast it.
A ray of light will emerge from your flat hand to illuminate your environment.
I am Loria, a former apprentice of Alatar, the Sage.
Time means nothing to me.
I hope you like it. It is named like my master, Alatar, the Sage.
Killing and destruction are just foolish steaps to entrophy.
He runs an equipment shop close to the north gate of the city.
Mana is the source of all magic. If you use spells, it will drain mana from your energy pool. This mana regenerates slowly, if you eat, or if you drink those mana potions you can buy at Xodet's
I am studying the power of magic all the time.

greet: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.

reply: This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ...
It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ...

The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ...
Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?

Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.

There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.

walkaway: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.

reply: I am Lost Traveler.
Oh, well. I might be a stranded time traveller that would appreciate your help.

farewell: May the gods protect you! And stay away from that hole!
greet: BEWARE! Beware of that {hole}!

reply: My name is Loui.
I'm a {monk}. I wanted to do something here, but I forgot what it was when I fell in that {hole}.
I'm a humble servant of the {gods}.
They created Tibia and all lifeforms.
I have no idea how long I've been in this {hole}. It seemed like an eternity!
While looking for something - which I forgot - I found that {hole}. I went down, even though I had no torch. And then I heard {THEM}! There must be dozens!
They were so many, EVERYWHERE! I could barely escape alive. I have no clue what THEY were but one more second down there and I'd have been dead!
Sorry, I'm out of mana and ingredients, please visit Cipfried in town.
The good thing is that those horrible rats stay mostly in town. The bad thing is that they do so because of bigger {monsters} that would devour them outside.
Everything around us, that is Tibia.
Most adventurers take their first steps there.
Pah, king! He should do something about this {hole}!
This is the place where everything starts.
Was it...? Yes, I might have looked for blueberries as I foolishly entered this unholy {hole}.
There must be an army of them, just down this {hole}.
Then, they must be magic wielding beasts using creature illusion! Good thing you escaped.
The gods blessed Tibia with abundant forms of life.
The good thing is that those horrible rats stay mostly in town. The bad thing is that they do so because of bigger {monsters} that would devour them outside.
I have no quests but to stay away from that {hole} and I recommend you to do the same.
I have no quests but to stay away from that {hole} and I recommend you to do the same.
I'm penniless and poor as becomes a humble monk like me.
I'm penniless and poor as becomes a humble monk like me.
She owns a shop in town.
She owns a shop in town.
She owns a shop in town.
She owns a bar in town.
Waaaah! Don't shock me like that!
He has his own monsters, I believe.
Harmless old woman.
He owns a shop in town.
Who's that? Never heard about her.
He owns a shop in town.
He's a farmer.
The gods may protect me from his rudeness.
A hermit on the other side of town.
The oracle! Yes! You should get off this island as fast as you can!
Young and inexperienced he is.
Seymour is the headmaster of the local {academy}.
I'm sure he has never seen monsters like those in this hole before.
I tried to warn him about these monsters but he just laughed at me!! It's an outrage!
I tried to warn him about these monsters but he just laughed at me!! It's an outrage!

entries.text: BEWARE! Beware of that hole!
STAY AWAY FROM THAT HOLE!
What are you doing here?? Get away from that hole!

greet: Welcome to my adventurer shop, |PLAYERNAME|! What do you need? Ask me for a {trade} to look at my wares.

reply: I am selling equipment for adventurers. If you need anything, let me know.
This is Ruffy my dog, please don't do him any harm.
I sell torches, fishing rods, worms, ropes, water hoses, backpacks, apples, and maps.
I am Lubo, the owner of this shop.
Oh! I'm sorry, I sold the last one just five minutes ago.
My hat? Hanna made this one for me.
Oh, you sure mean this old story about the mage Dago, who lost two fingers when he conjured a dragon.
There are some strange stories about a magicians pet names. Ask Hoggle about it.
It is said that once there lived a great magician on the top of this mountain.
I don't remember his name, but it's said that his banner was the black eye.
If you want to buy weapons, you'll have to go to a town or city.
There's a lot of magic flowing in the mountain to the north.
I sell the best apples in Tibia.
Frodo runs a nice inn in the near town Thais.

entries.text: Stop by and rest a while, tired adventurer! Have a look at my wares!

greet: What is it that you {want}, |PLAYERNAME|?

reply: That's none of your business!
So many claimed to have found and slain him but they had nothing to prove it.
After the ruthless seven conquered it, it's again a holy place for the followers of the dark path.
Infernatil, Pumin, Verminor, Tafariel, Apocalypse, Bazir and Ashfalor.
Fine, thank you for asking - I mean - I revel in the rising tide of evil and darkness that is engulfing this land, and I am loving every minute of it!
The demons are powerful followers of Zathroth. Their leaders are known as the ruthless seven.
The incendiary of hell.
It is said even speaking its TRUE name will bring total destruction upon you! <takes a step back from you>
It's existence is just a lie to inspire hope and bravery in the hearts of the followers of good.
He is one of Zathroth's most devoted followers and wields special powers, given to him by the Dark One.
Zathroth took her life, recoginzig it was necessary for the process of creation.
Oh please. Leave me alone with that rubbish.
They are a challenge to sift the chaff from the wheat.
Spreading anguish and divorcing couples are fun leisure activities. Are you married, you fool?
The glorious Gods of Darkness are Zathroth, Fafnar, Brog, Urgith, and the Archdemons. May they be praised!
Zathroth represents the true and unbound power of magic. He is the keeper of Great Secrets.
Ah, the Plaguelord.
She is the Mistress of the Damned! Rewarding or torturing, it is the same for her victims!
The right hand of Urgith. The general of the Undead Hordes.
The Elements are Tibia, Sula, Air and Fire.
The people of Tibia are sheep, so be smart and strong enough to become their wolf.
The necromant king was only defeated by the nightmare knights due to a bad twist of fate.
Bastesh is so afraid that she hides in the depth of the seas.
The people of Tibia are sheep, so be smart and strong enough to become their wolf.
I'm a servant of the only true God - Zathroth. As such I can also carry out divorces. Just in case you're interested.
Fafnar is the power of the sun. She burns the weak to ashes.
Urgith is the master of the undead. The Bonemaster is also patron of damned souls.
Fardos is the creator. He is a helpless watcher whose 'creation' is far more then he bargained for.
Crunor is the God of nature, of plants and trees ... and plants and trees are there to be stomped upon and burnt!
Nornur claims to be a God of Fate without even understanding the ways of fate at all.
The world of Tibia is there to be taken by the strongest. When the time is right, it will fall like an overripe plum...
Life is an eternal fight!
He is the Lord of Despair.
He is the Great Deciver, the Lord of Lies.
The so-called Gods of Good are Fardos, Uman, the Elements, Suon, Crunor, Nornur, Bastesh, Kirok, Toth, and Banor.
Kirok, the Mad One, is the patron of scientists and jesters, more a nuisance than a God.
Banor isn't a God at all, merely one of their tools. Is it not stupidity to worship a tool?
My name is Lugri.
Who cares?
You will soon see the 'news' with your own eyes, so be watchful! <chuckle>
This puny king is no threat for our master's plans.
Life is war. It's about survival of the fittest.
The weak have to be slain by the strong!
Your wounds are your problem, not mine.
The gods of darkness give us the chance to reach our whole potentials, the gods of good want to capture us in eternal stasis!
The glorious Gods of Darkness are Zathroth, Fafnar, Brog, Urgith, and the Archdemons. May they be praised!
Brog, the Raging One, the Great Destroyer, the Berserker of Darkness ... he has many names, but each inspires fear in the prudent.
The so-called Gods of Good are Fardos, Uman, the Elements, Suon, Crunor, Nornur, Bastesh, Kirok, Toth, and Banor.
Uman is a jealous keeper of magic. He shares only fragments of his knowledge with the mortals. To be strong one must take, not wait to be given, with Gods like that!.
Suon is one of the suns of our world. He gives his light mindlessly to the weak and the strong alike.
Toth is just the undertaker for the other 'gods of good'.
Sula is just the mindless elemental power of water.
Fire is just a mindless elemental force.
I am a priest of Zathroth, the bringer of dark secrets.
Air is just a mindless elemental force.

greet: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|! Do you feel adventurous? Do you want a weekly {ticket} for the ore wagon system here? You can use it right here to get to the centre of Kazordoon!
Greetings, traveller. Maybe you'd like to take a look at my {offers}...

reply: I'm selling various herbs, mushrooms, and flowers. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.

send_trade: Of course, just browse through my wares.

entries.text: Selling herbs, mushrooms and flowers, all picked under the light of the full moon!

reply: He good dwarf. Not kill me but gave me food and bandages. Me and Robson very great friends!

Other goblins always mean to me. Took me to human castle to steal stuff in their cellar. But we got alarm and metal men came after us. Me was cornered and fled through toilet. ... Me squeezed long way through stonecracks until me fell into water. ... Me thought me drown but nonono! Biggest fish ever came and swallowed me! Many long days in fish! Or even hours! But later suddenly fish was jumping much, then suddenly light! ... And me kind of: 'Oh! Goblin heaven!' but it was Robson who caught big fish! Imagine! He freed me and friends ever since! True story!

Dwarf are dangerous fighters. Me first very great fear of Robson because dwarf he is. But Robson good dwarf is. Not killing poor little goblin. ... Uh, of course mayhaps that making him bad dwarf, me not sure.
Ferry so noisy but good stink! Me always thought ferry would be little and have funny wings. Me know so little of big world!
Ferry so noisy but good stink! Me always thought ferry would be little and have funny wings. Me know so little of big world!
Me new name is Lunch.
Isle so scary. Evil monsters everywhere. Robson sometimes gone exploring. Me begging him not to go but he so brave. Gladly he always back for Lunch.

I am many, many things. Me bodyguard for Robson. Watching over him when sleeping. Me good fisherman. Me fish soo many fish that sometime no fish is left. ... Aaaand me many, many other things. All so more much fun with Robson. At home at goblin camp me only was punching ball for bigger goblins.
Me old name no word was. Hard to make noises for Robson. Robson named me Lunch because we met at lunchtime.
